fields.name: giant black ant
fields.desc: It's a large black ant.

fields.name: giant fire ant
fields.desc: It's a large red ant, wreathed in flames.

fields.name: giant ice ant
fields.desc: It's a large white ant. The air is frigid around it.

fields.name: giant lightning ant
fields.desc: It's a large yellow ant with sparks arcing across its body.

fields.name: giant acid ant
fields.desc: It's a large black ant.  Its porous skin oozes acid.

fields.name: giant army ant
fields.desc: It's a large ant with a heavy exoskeleton, geared for war.

fields.name: Queen Ant
fields.desc: Queen of the ants, queen of the biting death!

fields.name: giant eel
fields.desc: A snake-like being, moving toward you.

fields.name: electric eel
fields.desc: A snake-like being, radiating electricity.

fields.name: dragon turtle
fields.desc: A huge, elongated sea-green reptile.

fields.name: ancient dragon turtle
fields.desc: A huge, elongated sea-green reptile, it looks old and impenetrable.

fields.name: squid
fields.desc: Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to lock you down.

fields.name: ink squid
fields.desc: Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to blind you with its murky ink.

fields.name: water imp
fields.desc: A small water demon, lobbing spells at you.

fields.name: Walrog
fields.desc: Walrog, the lord of Water, is fearsome to behold. The water writhes around him as if trying to escape, making his form indistinct. He does not seem surprised to see you.

fields.name: brown bear
fields.desc: The weakest of bears, covered in brown shaggy fur.

fields.name: black bear
fields.desc: Do you smell like honey? 'Cause this bear wants honey.

fields.name: cave bear
fields.desc: It has come down from its cave foraging for food. Unfortunately, it found you.

fields.name: war bear
fields.desc: Bears with tusks, trained to kill.

fields.name: grizzly bear
fields.desc: A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.

fields.name: polar bear
fields.desc: This huge white bear has wandered south in search of food.

fields.name: Phoenix
fields.desc: Ever burning, ever dying, ever reviving, the Phoenix swoops down upon you, seeking to share its fiery fate with you.

fields.name: bone giant
fields.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of dozens of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.

fields.name: eternal bone giant
fields.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.

fields.name: heavy bone giant
fields.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.

fields.name: runed bone giant
fields.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies, rune-etched and infused with hateful sorceries.

fields.name: wolf
fields.desc: Lean, mean, and shaggy, it stares at you with hungry eyes.

fields.name: great wolf
fields.desc: Larger than a normal wolf, it prowls and snaps at you.

fields.name: dire wolf
fields.desc: Easily as big as a horse, this wolf menaces you with its claws and fangs.

fields.name: white wolf
fields.desc: A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and icy, and its fur coated in frost.

fields.name: warg
fields.desc: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning.

fields.name: fox
fields.desc: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

fields.name: Rungof the Warg Titan
fields.desc: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, thrice the size of a normal warg.

fields.name: cold drake hatchling
fields.desc: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.

fields.name: cold drake
fields.desc: A mature cold drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

fields.name: ice wyrm
fields.desc: An old and powerful cold drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

fields.name: broken golem
fields.desc: This golem is badly damaged.

fields.name: golem
fields.desc: This golem's eyes glow with magical energies.

fields.name: alchemist golem
fields.desc: This golem's eyes glow with magical energies.
A shining crystal formation charged with magical energies.

fields.name: wisp
fields.desc: A floating orb of magical energy. It shines with a radiant light. They explode upon contact.

fields.name: red crystal
fields.desc: A formation of red crystal. It emits bright red, scorching light.

fields.name: white crystal
fields.desc: A formation of white crystal. It emits bright white, chilling light.

fields.name: black crystal
fields.desc: A formation of black crystal. It absorbs all light around it.

fields.name: crimson crystal
fields.desc: A formation of crimson crystal. It emits a crimson light reminiscent of blood.

fields.name: blue crystal
fields.desc: A formation of blue crystal. Its light shines like the ocean's waves.

fields.name: multi-hued crystal
fields.desc: A formation of multi-hued crystal. It shines with all the colors of the rainbow.

fields.name: shimmering crystal
fields.desc: A formation of shimmering crystal. Orbs of light circle around it.

fields.name: elven mage
fields.desc: An elven mage, dressed in dark robes.

fields.name: elven tempest
fields.desc: An elven mage, dressed in crackling blue robes, and smelling of ozone.

fields.name: elven cultist
fields.desc: An elven cultist, dressed in sickening green robes.

fields.name: elven blood mage
fields.desc: An elven blood mage, dressing in dark, bloodied robes.

fields.name: elven corruptor
fields.desc: An elven corruptor, drawn to these blighted lands.

fields.name: elven guard
fields.desc: An elven guard.

fields.name: mean looking elven guard
fields.desc: An elven guard, scarred and sullen.

fields.name: elven warrior
fields.desc: An elven warrior, clad in heavy armour.

fields.name: elven elite warrior
fields.desc: An elven warrior, clad in heavy armour.

fields.name: faeros
fields.desc: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.

fields.name: greater faeros
fields.desc: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.

fields.name: ultimate faeros
fields.desc: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.

fields.name: snow cat
fields.desc: A large cat with a grey fur matted with black.

fields.name: panther
fields.desc: A large black cat, slender and muscular.

fields.name: tiger
fields.desc: A truly magnificent beast, with fur striped black and yellow.

fields.name: sabertooth tiger
fields.desc: This cat is simply enormous, and has fangs with the size and sharpness of short swords.

fields.name: fire drake hatchling
fields.desc: A drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.

fields.name: fire drake
fields.desc: A mature fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

fields.name: fire wyrm
fields.desc: An old and powerful fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

fields.name: dread
fields.desc: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself strives to banish it.

fields.name: dreadmaster
fields.desc: It is an unlife of power almost unequaled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crumble rock and wither flesh with ease.

fields.name: banshee
fields.desc: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.

fields.name: ruin banshee
fields.desc: A vengeful, screaming soul given form with the breath of Urh'Rok himself. The vapors of the Fearscape seep from its dimension-bending form, withering and searing.

fields.name: ghoul
fields.desc: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.

fields.name: ghast
fields.desc: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.

fields.name: ghoulking
fields.desc: Stench rises from this rotting abomination. Its brow is adorned with gold, and it moves at you with hatred gleaming in its eyes.

fields.name: risen corpse
fields.desc: A body raised through dark magic.

fields.name: gwelgoroth
fields.desc: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.

fields.name: greater gwelgoroth
fields.desc: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.

fields.name: ultimate gwelgoroth
fields.desc: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.

fields.name: entrenched horror
fields.desc: This massive stony structure shifts and pulsates, its many long, thin tentacles probing the nearby water for food.

fields.name: swarming horror
fields.desc: This tiny fish-like creature moves erratically, but is constantly surrounded by others of its kind.

fields.name: ravenous horror
fields.desc: A vile looking liquid flows from the teeth of this agile monster. It glides through the water towards you, spined fins jutting outwards.

fields.name: boiling horror
fields.desc: This frothing ball of water rages with an intense heat.

fields.name: swarm hive
fields.desc: This titanic mass of flesh pulsates and churns as tiny monsters burst from its orifices.

fields.name: abyssal horror
fields.desc: This pitch black form is shrouded in darkness. All you can make out are a pair of deep red eyes, hidden behind a mass of tentacles.

fields.name: dredgling
fields.desc: A small pink-skinned humanoid with large bulbous eyes.

fields.name: dredge
fields.desc: A hulking pink-skinned creature with long arms as thick as tree trunks.  It drags its knuckles on the ground as it lumbers toward you.

fields.name: dredge captain
fields.desc: A thin pink-skinned creature with long spindly arms.  Half its body is old and wrinkly, and the other half appears quite young.

fields.name: temporal stalker
fields.desc: A slender metallic monstrosity with long claws in place of fingers, and razor-sharp teeth.

fields.name: void horror
fields.desc: It looks like a hole in spacetime, but you get the impression it's somehow more than that.

fields.name: drem
fields.desc: A small faceless humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features.  Its waraxe and shield look battered, rusted, and generally in ill repair.

fields.name: dremling
fields.desc: A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits.  Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.

fields.name: drem master
fields.desc: A disfigured humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features dressed in patched-together and rusted mail armor.  It seems to be in command of others, though its mouth is sewn shut.

fields.name: brecklorn
fields.desc: A giant hairless bat with the face of a Dwarf twisted into a constant scream.  Pustulant sores cover its malformed body, and your heart weakens as it nears.

fields.name: grannor'vor
fields.desc: A large sluglike creature that moves slowly, leaving a trail of acid in its wake.  Its head has strangely humanoid features.

fields.name: grannor'vin
fields.desc: A large sluglike creature with the face of a man.  Shadows seem to be drawn to its massive form, and your light dims as it approaches.

fields.name: necrotic mass
fields.desc: This putrid mass of rotting flesh shifts and quivers, but shows no signs of intelligence or mobility.

fields.name: necrotic abomination
fields.desc: This monstrous form of putrid, torn flesh and chipped bone drags its mass towards you, spurting blood and viscera along the way.

fields.name: bone horror
fields.desc: The massive ribcage in the middle beats with loud, audible cracks, as many a skeletal hand protrude forth, entwining, fusing, forming long skeletal appendages to support itself, while others crumble and collapse inward. During all this, somehow, it seems they grasp for you.

fields.name: sanguine horror
fields.desc: This pulsing, quivering form is a deep crimson, and appears to be composed entirely of thick, virulent blood. Waves rhythmically ripple across its surface, indicating a still beating heart somewhere in its body.

fields.name: animated blood
fields.desc: This crimson shape drips ceaselessly, spattering the nearby ground. The droplets seem to continue moving of their own volition.

fields.name: worm that walks
fields.desc:
A bulging rotten robe seems to tear at the seams, with masses of bloated worms spilling out all around the moving form.  Two arm-like appendages, each made up of overlapping mucous-drenched maggots, grasp tightly around the handles of bile-coated waraxes.
Each swing drips pustulant fluid before it, and each droplet writhes and wriggles in the air before splashing against the ground.

fields.name: bloated horror
fields.desc: A bulbous humanoid form floats here. Its bald, child-like head is disproportionately large compared to its body, and its skin is pock-marked with nasty red sores.

fields.name: nightmare horror
fields.desc: A shifting form of darkest night that seems to reflect your deepest fears.

fields.name: headless horror
fields.desc: A headless, gangly humanoid with a large distended stomach.

fields.name: eldritch eye
fields.desc: A small bloodshot eye floats here.

fields.name: luminous horror
fields.desc: A lanky humanoid shape composed of yellow light.

fields.name: radiant horror
fields.desc: A lanky four-armed humanoid shape composed of bright golden light.  It's so bright it's hard to look at, and you can feel heat radiating outward from it.

fields.name: devourer
fields.desc: A headless, round creature with stubby legs and arms.  Its body seems to be all teeth.

fields.name: blade horror
fields.desc: Blades whirl in the air around this thin, floating figure. The air around it swirls with force, threatening to tear apart anything that approches, if the blades don't do it first.

fields.name: oozing horror
fields.desc: A massive, amorphous blob of green slime crawls on the ground towards you. Eyes drift through the viscous mass, scanning for potential prey.

fields.name: umbral horror
fields.desc: A dark shifting shape stalks through the shadows, blending in seamlessly.

fields.name: dreaming horror
fields.desc:
A vaguely tentacled yet constantly changing form rests here apparently oblivious to your existence.
With each slow breath it takes reality distorts around it.  Blue twirls into red, green twists into yellow, and the air sings softly before bursting into a myriad of pastel shapes and colors.

fields.name: dream seed
fields.desc: A pinkish bubble floats here, reflecting the world not as it is, but as it would be in that surreal place that exists only in our dreams.

fields.name: maelstrom
fields.desc: This powerful vortex of ice and lightning somehow gives you the impression of claws, teeth and intense hunger...

fields.name: parasitic horror
fields.desc: You don't want to think about what sort of creature this lamprey-like horror was feeding on to grow so large.  Its skin pulsates and writhes, like things are moving underneath...

fields.name: mass of parasitic leeches
fields.desc: Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.

fields.name: Grgglck the Devouring Darkness
fields.desc:
A horror from the deepest pits of the earth. It looks like a huge pile of tentacles all trying to reach for you.
You can discern a huge round mouth covered in razor-sharp teeth.

fields.name: Grgglck's Tentacle
fields.desc: This is one of Grgglck's tentacles. It looks more vulnerable than the main body.

fields.name: Ak'Gishil
fields.desc: This Blade Horror has been infused with intense temporal magic, causing its power to increase dramatically. Rifts in space open around it constantly, summoning and banishing blades before vanishing as quickly as they appear.

fields.name: Animated Sword
fields.desc: Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.

fields.name: Distorted Animated Sword
fields.desc: This floating weapon shifts and shimmers, time and space warping and bending as it moves. It appears to vibrate, as if it may explode at any moment.
A strange blob on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: green jelly
fields.desc: A strange green blob on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: red jelly
fields.desc: A strange red blob on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: blue jelly
fields.desc: A strange blue blob on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: white jelly
fields.desc: A strange white blob on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: yellow jelly
fields.desc: A strange yellow blob on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: black jelly
fields.desc: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: Malevolent Dimensional Jelly
fields.desc: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor; through it you seem to be able to see other times and places. As you stare you see things moving out of it.

Only the most powerful spellcasters raised to unlife become liches. Doomed to haunt the world for an eternity, they have grown to hate all that breathes or trespasses on their domain. Unfortunately that includes you.

fields.name: lich
fields.desc: Having thought to discover life eternal, these beings have allowed undeath to rob them of the joys of life. Now they seek to destroy it as well.

fields.name: ancient lich
fields.desc: An elder being from a now-forgotten age, filled and fueled by its hate and rage toward all things living, it seeks to deprive all others of a prize it cannot have... life.

fields.name: archlich
fields.desc: Blacker than the deepest night, this cold cruel form of darkness approaches.  Long ago it laid aside its mortality, but it has not forgotten its power; rather, its malice and hate have bent this undead entity on the destruction of all things living.

fields.name: blood lich
fields.desc: The seething, pumping, disembodied blood of a horrendously powerful necromancer. To strike it is to bathe in the rivers of the Fearscape itself.
Losgoroth are mighty void elementals, native to the void between the stars. They are rarely seen on a planet's surface.

fields.name: manaworm
fields.desc: Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.

fields.name: dolleg
fields.desc: A monstrous demon, covered in acidic thorns.

fields.name: dúathedlen
fields.desc: Under a shroud of darkness you discern an evil shape.

fields.name: uruivellas
fields.desc:
This demon would look like a minotaur, if a minotaur had a fiery aura surrounding it and horns all over its body.
Oh, and it is twice as big, too.

fields.name: thaurhereg
fields.desc: This terrible demon is covered in blood, which flows *on* its skin in ever-changing patterns that disturb you simply when looking at it.

fields.name: daelach
fields.desc:
You can only guess at the real shape of this demon. Its body is surrounded by a cloud of fiery darkness.
It moves swiftly toward you, casting terrible spells and swinging its weapons at you.

fields.name: champion of Urh'Rok
fields.desc: One of Urh'Rok's own champions. A thousand nightmares made flesh and screaming steel tower before you in the form of a massive, armored humanoid.

fields.name: forge-giant
fields.desc: A burning giant wielding a forge hammer of the underworld in each hand -- weapons imbued by Urh'Rok himself with the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril.

fields.name: Khulmanar, General of Urh'Rok
fields.desc: This massive form, sheathed in dark flames, stands tall above a legion of lesser demons. In his hands he holds a massive blackened battleaxe, flames dancing around the blades.

fields.name: fire imp
fields.desc: A small demon, lobbing spells at you.

fields.name: wretchling
fields.desc: Acid oozes all over this small demon's skin.  Beware, they tend to hunt in packs.

fields.name: onilug
fields.desc:
A gaunt vaguely humanoid shape featuring unadorned grey leathery skin. Its arms and legs seem somehow too long and it stands tall, projecting an ominous shadow even in darkness.
Its glowing red eyes shine with both cruelty and a deep frightening intellect.

fields.name: quasit
fields.desc: A small, heavily armoured demon, rushing toward you.

fields.name: minotaur
fields.desc: It is a cross between a human and a bull.

fields.name: maulotaur
fields.desc: A belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, and armed with a hammer.
A strange growth on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: grey mold
fields.desc: A strange grey growth on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: brown mold
fields.desc: A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: shining mold
fields.desc: A strange luminescent growth on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: green mold
fields.desc: A strange sickly green growth on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: Z'quikzshl the skeletal mold
fields.desc: Steeped in fungal malevolence, this mold refused to die.  How a mold becomes a skeleton, though, is beyond you.  Are those its own bones, or the bones of hapless adventurers?

fields.name: multi-hued drake hatchling
fields.desc: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.

fields.name: multi-hued drake
fields.desc: A mature multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.

fields.name: greater multi-hued wyrm
fields.desc: An old and powerful multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.

fields.name: Ureslak the Prismatic
fields.desc: A huge multi-hued drake. It seems to shift color rapidly.

fields.name: naga myrmidon
fields.desc: Before you stands a tall figure -- a very tall figure, propped high by a thick serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is human-like, with bulging muscles beneath fitted armour, and large hands gripping a fiercely sharp trident. He glares at you with dark intensity, like a wolf about to pounce on unsuspecting prey.

fields.name: naga tide huntress
fields.desc: Though the sharp point of an arrow pointed steadily at your head is of concern, more unnerving is the creature that wields it: a slim and lithe woman from the waist up, but a terrifying giant serpent beneath, her tail stretching for several feet behind her. Her eyes turn cold and ice seems to magically condense on the tip of her barbed arrow. Suddenly it is of concern again.

fields.name: naga psyren
fields.desc: Such a mix of enchanting beauty and revolting horror you have never before seen combined. Above, a beautiful, ethereal woman, of scant form and entrancing grace. Below, the thick, smooth scales of a snake, its stretched tail gently waving back and forth in the air behind her. The movement is eye-catching and hypnotic, and whilst you watch a mysterious smile plays across her seductive lips.

fields.name: ogre guard
fields.desc: A maul-wield ogre. Ready to CRUSH!

fields.name: ogre warmaster
fields.desc: A master of combat, she is impatient to test her newfound skills.

fields.name: ogre mauler
fields.desc: Crush! Destroy! Maim!

fields.name: ogre pounder
fields.desc: This ogre closes in fast on you, arms open for the hug of death.

fields.name: ogre rune-spinner
fields.desc: A towering ogre guard, her skin covered in runes and arcane designs.
It's colorful and it's oozing.

fields.name: green ooze
fields.desc: It's green and it's oozing.

fields.name: red ooze
fields.desc: It's red and it's oozing.

fields.name: blue ooze
fields.desc: It's blue and it's oozing.

fields.name: white ooze
fields.desc: It's white and it's oozing.

fields.name: yellow ooze
fields.desc: It's yellow and it's oozing.

fields.name: black ooze
fields.desc: It's black and it's oozing.

fields.name: gelatinous cube
fields.desc:
It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols.
Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.

fields.name: crimson ooze
fields.desc: It's reddish and it's oozing.

fields.name: brittle clear ooze
fields.desc: It's translucent and it's oozing.

fields.name: slimy ooze
fields.desc: It's very slimy and it's oozing.

fields.name: poison ooze
fields.desc: It's very slimy and it's oozing.

fields.name: orc summoner
fields.desc: A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.

fields.name: orc grand summoner
fields.desc: A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.

fields.name: orc master wyrmic
fields.desc: A fierce soldier-orc highly trained in the discipline of dragons.

fields.name: orc mage-hunter
fields.desc: An orc clad in massive armour. Magic seems to die down all around him.

fields.name: orc fighter
fields.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.

fields.name: orc elite fighter
fields.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.

fields.name: orc berserker
fields.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a huge axe.

fields.name: orc elite berserker
fields.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a huge axe.

fields.name: orc necromancer
fields.desc: An orc dressed in black robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.

fields.name: orc blood mage
fields.desc: An orc dressed in blood-stained robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.

fields.name: orc corruptor
fields.desc: An orc dressed in putrid robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.

fields.name: orc pyromancer
fields.desc: An orc dressed in bright red robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.

fields.name: orc high pyromancer
fields.desc: An orc dressed in bright red robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.

fields.name: orc cryomancer
fields.desc: An orc dressed in cold blue robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.

fields.name: orc high cryomancer
fields.desc: An orc dressed in cold blue robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.

fields.name: orc warrior
fields.desc: He is a hardy, well-weathered survivor.

fields.name: orc archer
fields.desc: He is a hardy, well-weathered survivor.

fields.name: orc soldier
fields.desc: A fierce soldier-orc.

fields.name: fiery orc wyrmic
fields.desc: A fierce soldier-orc trained in the discipline of dragons.

fields.name: icy orc wyrmic
fields.desc: A fierce soldier-orc trained in the discipline of dragons.

fields.name: orc assassin
fields.desc: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.

fields.name: orc master assassin
fields.desc: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.

fields.name: orc grand master assassin
fields.desc: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.

fields.name: Kra'Tor the Gluttonous
fields.desc: A morbidly obese orc with greasy pockmarked skin and oily long black hair.  He's clad in plate mail and carries a huge granite battleaxe that's nearly as large as he is.
A not-so-strange growth on the dungeon floor.

fields.name: giant venus flytrap
fields.desc: This flesh-eating plant has grown to enormous proportions and seeks to quell its hunger.

fields.name: treant
fields.desc: A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile to other living things.

fields.name: poison ivy
fields.desc: This harmless little plant makes you all itchy.

fields.name: honey tree
fields.desc: As you approach it, you hear a high-pitched buzzing sound.

Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.

fields.name: giant rabbit
fields.desc: Kill the wabbit, kill the wabbit, kill the wabbbbbiiiiiit.

fields.name: giant crystal rat
fields.desc: Instead of fur, this rat has crystals growing on its back, which provide extra protection.

fields.name: sandworm
fields.desc: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. It seems quite unhappy about you being in its lair.

fields.name: sandworm destroyer
fields.desc: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. This particular sandworm seems to have been bred for one purpose only: the eradication of everything that is non-sandworm, such as... you.

fields.name: sand-drake
fields.desc: This unholy creature looks like a wingless dragon in shape, but it is sand-colored, making it all the more dangerous for its prey.

fields.name: gigantic sandworm tunneler
fields.desc: The ground shakes as this huge worm burrows towards you, its gigantic mouth just as capable of devouring flesh as stone.

fields.name: gigantic gravity worm
fields.desc: Space and time seem to bend around this huge worm.

fields.name: gigantic corrosive tunneler
fields.desc: This huge worm burrows through the earth using its powerful corrosive saliva.
Through some terrible process that remains mysterious, this creature's shadow has been torn from its body and given unlife.
Through some terrible process that remains mysterious, this creature's shadow has been torn from its body and given unlife.
Through some terrible process that remains mysterious, this creature's shadow has been torn from its body and given unlife.

fields.name: shivgoroth
fields.desc: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.

fields.name: greater shivgoroth
fields.desc: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.

fields.name: ultimate shivgoroth
fields.desc: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.

fields.name: degenerated skeleton warrior
fields.desc: A haphazard collection of crumbling bones, with jerky movements that remind you of a child playing with a marionette.  It only has one arm, but that's all it needs to hold a sword.

fields.name: degenerated skeleton archer
fields.desc: A frail skeleton; just about the only bones that aren't cracked are its arms.  It's missing a hand, but a notch has been carved into its wrist to let it pull back a bowstring regardless.

fields.name: skeleton mage
fields.desc: Given its condition, you're less inclined to think this skeleton knows proper spells, rather than simply disgorging its magical energy as it breaks down.  This doesn't make it much less dangerous to be around, mind you.

fields.name: skeleton warrior
fields.desc: The forces binding this skeleton together are resilient enough to let it hold a shield and swing a weapon as well as it could have in life.  It's still wearing its old armor, in rusty but servicable condition.

fields.name: skeleton archer
fields.desc: Nobody scavenged the high-quality bow from this archer before it was raised from the dead.  You're about to wish the world had more grave-robbers.

fields.name: skeleton magus
fields.desc: This skeleton has been imbued with far more magical energy than normal, and serves as a conduit of its master's spellcasting prowess.

fields.name: armoured skeleton warrior
fields.desc: It feels no pain.  It moves with fluidity and strength that would tear natural muscles apart.  It must be from a fresh corpse, since its bones, armor, and weapon are all in pristine condition.  And it's furious.

fields.name: skeleton master archer
fields.desc: This skeleton can fire arrows and nock new ones with blinding speed.  Arcane forces pull its bones with unnatural precision - its arms will never tremble or get tired.

fields.name: skeleton assassin
fields.desc: Most skeletons announce their presence with a chorus of rattling bones; this one's been charred black and has enough cartilage between its joints to muffle its approach.  The first you'll see of it will be the flash of its blade.

fields.name: large brown snake
fields.desc: This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.

fields.name: large white snake
fields.desc: This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.

fields.name: copperhead snake
fields.desc: It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.

fields.name: rattlesnake
fields.desc: As you approach, the snake coils up and rattles its tail threateningly.

fields.name: king cobra
fields.desc: It is a large snake with a hooded face.

fields.name: black mamba
fields.desc: It has glistening black skin, a sleek body, and highly venomous fangs.

fields.name: anaconda
fields.desc: You recoil in fear as you notice this gigantic snake.  It seeks to crush the life out of you.

fields.name: snow giant
fields.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.

fields.name: snow giant thunderer
fields.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly. Lightning crackles over its body.

fields.name: snow giant boulder thrower
fields.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.

fields.name: snow giant chieftain
fields.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.

fields.name: Burb the snow giant champion
fields.desc: A maddened, enraged snow giant that towers over his comrades. You've heard legends mentioning this particular monstrosity; they say that when he's not rampaging around frothing at the mouth, he sits, almost childlike, engraving stories and mysterious patterns on any flat stone surface he can find.
Arachnophobia...

fields.name: giant spider
fields.desc: A huge arachnid, it produces even bigger webs.

fields.name: spitting spider
fields.desc: A huge arachnid, it sprays venom at its prey.

fields.name: chitinous spider
fields.desc: A huge arachnid with a massive exoskeleton.

fields.name: gaeramarth
fields.desc: These cunning spiders terrorize those who enter the ever-growing borders of their lairs.  Those who encounter them rarely return.

fields.name: ninurlhing
fields.desc: The air reeks with noxious fumes and the ground around it decays.

fields.name: faerlhing
fields.desc: This spider seems to command the flow of mana, which pulses freely through its body.

fields.name: ungolmor
fields.desc: Largest of all the spiderkin, its folds of skin seem nearly impenetrable.

fields.name: losselhing
fields.desc: The air seems to freeze solid around this frigid spider.

fields.name: weaver young
fields.desc: A tiny arachnid that phases in and out of reality.

fields.name: weaver patriarch
fields.desc: A large blue arachnid with white markings on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.

fields.name: weaver matriarch
fields.desc: A large dark blue arachnid with a shifting yellow and white pattern on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.

fields.name: Ninandra, the Great Weaver
fields.desc: A huge blue and white spiderkin whose form shifts and shimmers in and out of reality.  She spins the threads of fate and binds the destiny of all within her web.

fields.name: storm drake hatchling
fields.desc: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.

fields.name: storm drake
fields.desc: A mature storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

fields.name: storm wyrm
fields.desc: An old and powerful storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

fields.name: human guard
fields.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.

fields.name: elven archer
fields.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.

fields.name: human sun-paladin
fields.desc: A human in shiny plate armour.

fields.name: elven sun-mage
fields.desc: An elf dressed in glowing robes.
Buzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz.

fields.name: midge swarm
fields.desc: A swarm of midges; they want blood.

fields.name: bee swarm
fields.desc: They buzz at you threateningly, as you have gotten too close to their hive.

fields.name: hornet swarm
fields.desc: You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.

fields.name: hummerhorn
fields.desc: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger dripping venom.

fields.killer_message: and lost outside time

fields.name: telugoroth
fields.desc: A temporal elemental, rarely encountered except by those who travel through time itself.  Its blurred form constantly shifts before your eyes.

fields.name: greater telugoroth
fields.desc: A temporal elemental, rarely encountered except by those who travel through time itself.  Its blurred form constantly shifts before your eyes.

fields.name: ultimate telugoroth
fields.desc: A temporal elemental, rarely encountered except by those who travel through time itself.  Its blurred form constantly shifts before your eyes.

fields.name: teluvorta
fields.desc: Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.

fields.name: greater teluvorta
fields.desc: Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.

fields.name: ultimate teluvorta
fields.desc: Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.

fields.name: cutpurse
fields.desc: The lowest of the thieves, this cutpurse is just learning the tricks of the trade.

fields.name: rogue
fields.desc: Stronger than a cutpurse, this thief has been promoted.

fields.name: thief
fields.desc: He eyes you and your belongings, then suddenly vanishes... strange, why is your pack lighter?

fields.name: bandit
fields.desc: These ruffians often employ brute force over thievery, but they are capable of stealing as well.

fields.name: bandit lord
fields.desc: He is the leader of a gang of bandits. Watch out for his underlings.

fields.name: assassin
fields.desc: Before you looms a pair of eyes... a glint of steel... death.

fields.name: shadowblade
fields.desc: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!

fields.name: rogue sapper
fields.desc: Stealthy tricksters that leave a wake of deadfalls and other hazards.  They really just make a mess of things.

fields.name: forest troll
fields.desc: Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.

fields.name: stone troll
fields.desc: A giant troll with scabrous black skin. With a shudder, you notice the belt of dwarf skulls around his massive waist.

fields.name: cave troll
fields.desc: This huge troll wields a massive spear and has a disturbingly intelligent look in its piggy eyes.

fields.name: mountain troll
fields.desc: A large and athletic troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.

fields.name: mountain troll thunderer
fields.desc: A large and athletic troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.

fields.name: patchwork troll
fields.desc: A disgusting and mismatched construct of necromantically-enhanced troll bits and shattered weapons. Confused and furious, it rends and shatters its surroundings with impossible strength, moving with speed found nowhere in nature.

fields.name: Forest Troll Hedge-Wizard
fields.desc: This old-looking troll glares at you with malice. His muscles appear atrophied, but a certain power surrounds him nonetheless.

fields.name: skeletal rat
fields.desc: A skeletal rat, teeth and claws ground to a sharp point. It glares at you menacingly.

fields.name: ghoulish rat
fields.desc: Layers of rotting skin are peeling off of this rat. One of the eye sockets appears empty.

fields.name: spectral rat
fields.desc: An eerie haze surrounds this translucent rat.

fields.name: vampire rat
fields.desc: Looks much like a normal rat. That is, other than the very large fangs.

fields.name: gigantic bone rat
fields.desc: This massive beast appears to be a rat composed of countless bones fused together.

fields.name: Rat Lich
fields.desc: The master of the pit is before you. It squeaks with menace as it and a horde of minions approach you.
These ancient cursed beings often take the form of a bat and attack their prey.

fields.name: lesser vampire
fields.desc: This vampire has only just begun its new life. It has not yet fathomed its newfound power, yet it still has a thirst for blood.

fields.name: vampire
fields.desc: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.

fields.name: master vampire
fields.desc: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.

fields.name: elder vampire
fields.desc:
A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others.
It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.

fields.name: vampire lord
fields.desc: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.

fields.name: venom drake hatchling
fields.desc: A corrosive venom drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.

fields.name: venom drake
fields.desc: A mature corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.

fields.name: venom wyrm
fields.desc: An old and powerful corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
These be white wights.

fields.name: forest wight
fields.desc: It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.

fields.name: grave wight
fields.desc: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.

fields.name: barrow wight
fields.desc: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.

fields.name: emperor wight
fields.desc: Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.

fields.name: spire dragon
fields.desc: A monstrous, coiled wyrm, patient and hateful. Its hide, studded with spikes and crests and blades, turns aside steel and sorcery with equal ease.

fields.name: blinkwyrm
fields.desc: A shifting, writhing, snake-like dragon, blinking in and out of existence, just waiting for you to turn your back.

fields.name: umber hulk
fields.desc: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.

fields.name: xorn
fields.desc: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.

fields.name: xaren
fields.desc: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.

fields.name: The Fragmented Essence of Harkor'Zun
fields.desc: Fragmented essence... maybe it'd be best if it stayed fragmented.

fields.name: Harkor'Zun
fields.desc: A gigantic demon composed of elemental Earth, resembling a twisted Xaren but much, much larger.  It doesn't seem pleased with your presence.

fields.name: yaech diver
fields.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.

fields.name: yaech hunter
fields.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.

fields.name: yaech mindslayer
fields.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.

fields.name: yaech psion
fields.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.

fields.killer_message: and burned on a pyre

fields.name: ziguranth warrior
fields.desc: A Ziguranth warrior, clad in heavy armour.

fields.name: ziguranth summoner
fields.desc: A Ziguranth wilder, attuned to nature.

fields.name: ziguranth wyrmic
fields.desc: A Ziguranth wilder, attuned to nature.
Massive two-handed battleaxes.
Massive two-handed mauls.
Massive two-handed swords.

A two-handed massive trident.
Tridents require the exotic weapons mastery talent to use correctly.
One-handed war axes.

fields.name: Life Drinker
fields.desc: Black blood for foul deeds. This dagger serves evil.

fields.name: Trident of the Tides
fields.desc:
The power of the tides rush through this trident.
Tridents require the exotic weapons mastery talent to use correctly.

fields.name: Fiery Choker
fields.desc: A choker made of pure flame, casting forever shifting patterns around the neck of its wearer. Its fire seems to not harm the wearer.

fields.name: Chromatic Harness
fields.desc: This dragon scale harness shines with multiple colors, quickly shifting through them in a seemingly chaotic manner.

fields.name: Glory of the Pride
fields.desc: The most prized treasure of the Battlemaster of the Pride, Grushnak. This gold ring is inscribed in the now lost orc tongue.

fields.name: Black Robe
fields.desc: A silk robe, darker than the darkest night sky, it radiates power.

fields.name: Crown of the Elements
fields.desc: This jeweled crown shimmers with colors.

fields.name: Warmaster Gnarg's Murderblade
fields.desc: A blood-etched greatsword, it has seen many foes. From the inside.
combat: 10% chance to send the wielder into a killing frenzy

fields.name: Whip of Urh'Rok
fields.desc: With this unbearably bright whip of flame, the demon master Urh'Rok has become known for never having lost in combat.

fields.name: Storm Fury
fields.desc: This dragonbone longbow is enhanced with bands of steel, which arc with intense lightning. Bolts travel up and down the string, ignorant of you.

fields.name: Frozen Shroud
fields.desc: All that remains of the Glacial Legion. This cloak seems to exude an icy cold vapor that freezes all it touches.
use_power: release a radius %d chilling blast, instantly dealing %0.2f cold damage and condensing the air into freezing vapors that deal %0.2f cold damage (based on Magic) each turn for %d turns

fields.name: Blighted Maul
fields.desc: The massive stone limb of the Rotting Titan, a mass of stone and rotting flesh. You think you can lift it, but it is very heavy.
combat: Blasts creatures in a radius 1 shockwave around your target for %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Strength).
%s's %s shakes the ground with its impact!
use_power: knock away other creatures within radius %d), dealing %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Strength) to each
%s slams %s %s into the ground, sending out a shockwave!

fields.name: Molten Skin
fields.desc: This mass of fused molten bone from the Heavy Sentinel radiates intense power. It still glows red with the heat of the Sentinel's core, and yet seems to do you no harm.

fields.name: Void Orb
fields.desc: This thin grey ring is adorned with a deep black orb. Tiny white dots swirl slowly within it, and a faint purple light glows from its core.

fields.name: Wintertide
fields.desc:
The air seems to freeze around the blade of this sword, draining all heat from the area.
It is said the Conclave created this weapon for their warmaster during the dark times of the first allure war.
combat: Create a Winter Storm that gradually expands (from radius %d to radius %d), dealing %0.2f cold damage (based on Strength) to your enemies each turn and slowing their ability to act by 20%%.  Subsequent melee strikes will relocate the storm on top of your target and increase its duration.
use_power: precipitate ice walls (lasting 10 turns) within your Winter Storm's area
#LIGHT_BLUE#%s brandishes %s %s, releasing a wave of Winter cold!

fields.name: Wintertide Phial
fields.desc: This phial seems filled with darkness, yet it cleanses your thoughts.
use_power: cleanse your mind of up to %d (based on Magic) detrimental mental effects

fields.name: Frost Treads
fields.desc: A pair of leather boots. Cold to the touch, they radiate a cold blue light.

fields.name: Dragonskull Helm
fields.desc: Traces of a dragon's power still remain in this bleached and cracked skull.

fields.name: Eel-skin armour
fields.desc: This armour seems to have been patched together from many eels. Yuck.

fields.name: Nightsong
fields.desc: A pitch black ring, unadorned. It seems as though tendrils of darkness creep upon it.

fields.name: Steel Helm of Garkul
fields.desc: A great helm that belonged to Garkul the Devourer, one of the greatest orcs ever to live.
set_desc: Another of Garkul's heirlooms would bring out his spirit.

fields.name: Lunar Shield
fields.desc: A large section of chitin removed from Nimisil. It continues to give off a strange white glow.

fields.name: Wrathroot's Barkwood
fields.desc: The barkwood of Wrathroot, made into roughly the shape of a shield.

fields.name: Petrified Wood
fields.desc: A piece of the scorched wood taken from the remains of Snaproot.

fields.name: Crystal Shard
fields.desc: This crystalline tree branch is remarkably rigid, and refracts light in myriad colors. Gazing at it entrances you, and you worry where its power may have come from.
use_power: create 2 living shards of crystal to serve you for 10 turns
You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
Crystals splinter off of %s's %s and animate!

fields.name: Malediction
fields.desc: The land withers and crumbles wherever this cursed axe rests.

fields.name: Kor's Fall
fields.desc: Made from the bones of many creatures, this staff glows with power. You can feel its evil presence even from a distance.

fields.name: Vox
fields.desc: No force can hope to silence the wearer of this amulet.

fields.name: Telos's Staff (Top Half)
fields.desc: The top part of Telos' broken staff.

fields.name: Choker of Dread
fields.desc: The evilness of undeath radiates from this amulet.
use_power: summon an elder vampire with Taunt to your side for 15 turns
You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
You need an enemy nearby to summon!

A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others. It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.

fields.name: Runed Skull
fields.desc: Dull red runes are etched all over this blackened skull.

fields.name: Bill's Tree Trunk
fields.desc: This is a big, nasty-looking tree trunk that Bill the Troll used as a weapon. It could still serve this purpose, should you be strong enough to wield it!

fields.name: Sanguine Shield
fields.desc: Though tarnished and spattered with blood, the emblem of the Sun still manages to shine through on this shield.

fields.name: Flamewrought
fields.desc: These gloves seems to be made out of the exoskeletons of ritches. They are hot to the touch.

fields.name: Crystal Focus
fields.desc: This crystal radiates the power of the Spellblaze itself.
use_power: combine with a weapon (makes a non enchanted weapon into an artifact)
#GOLD#As the crystalline weapon and armour are brought together, they begin to emit a constant humming.
#GOLD#The humming from the crystalline artifacts fades as they are separated.
Transformed with the power of the Spellblaze.
recover the Crystal Focus (destroys this weapon)
You fix the crystal on the %s and create the %s.

fields.name: Crystal Heart
fields.desc: This crystal is huge, easily the size of your head. It sparkles brilliantly almost of its own accord.
use_power: combine with a suit of body armor (makes a non enchanted armour into an artifact)
Transformed with the power of the Spellblaze.
recover the Crystal Heart (destroys this armour)
You fix the crystal on the %s and create the %s.

fields.name: Rod of Annulment
fields.desc: You can feel magic draining out around this rod. Even nature itself seems affected.
use_power: put up to 3 of the target's runes, infusions or talents on cooldown for 3-5 turns (range %d)

fields.name: Skullcleaver
fields.desc: A small but sharp axe, with a handle made of polished bone.  The blade has chopped through the skulls of many, and has been stained a deep crimson.

fields.name: Tooth of the Mouth
fields.desc: A huge tooth taken from the Mouth, in the Deep Bellow.

fields.name: The Warped Boots
fields.desc: These blackened boots have lost all vestiges of any former glory they might have had. Now, they are a testament to the corruption of the Deep Bellow, and its power.

fields.name: Withering Orbs
fields.desc:
These opalescent orbs stare at you with deathly knowledge, undeceived by your vanities and pretences.  They have lived and died through horrors you could never imagine, and now they lie strung in black chords watching every twitch of the shadows.
If you close your eyes a moment, you can almost imagine what dread sights they see...

fields.name: Borfast's Cage
fields.unided_name: a suit of pitted and pocked plate-mail
fields.desc:
Inch-thick stralite plates lock together with voratun joints. The whole suit looks impenetrable, but has clearly been subjected to terrible treatment - great dents and misshaping warps, and caustic fissures bored across the surface.
Though clearly a powerful piece, it must once have been much greater.

fields.name: Aletta's Diadem
fields.desc:
A filigree of silver set with many small jewels, this diadem seems radiant - ethereal almost. But its touch seems to freeze your skin and brings wild thoughts to your mind. You want to drop it, throw it away, and yet you cannot resist thinking of what powers it might bring you.
Is this temptation a weak will on your part, or some domination from the artifact itself...?

fields.name: Hare-Skin Sling
fields.desc:
This well-tended sling is made from the leather and sinews of a large hare. It feels smooth to the touch, yet very durable. Some say that the skin of a hare brings luck and fortune.
Hard to tell if that really helped its former owner, but it's clear that the skin is at least also strong and reliable.

fields.name: Prox's Lucky Halfling Foot
fields.desc:
A large hairy foot, very recognizably a halfling's, is strung on a piece of thick twine. In its decomposed state it's hard to tell how long ago it parted with its owner, but from what look like teeth marks around the ankle you get the impression that it wasn't given willingly.
It has been kept somewhat intact with layers of salt and clay, but in spite of this it's clear that nature is beginning to take its toll on the dead flesh. Some say the foot of a halfling brings luck to its bearer - right now the only thing you can be sure of is that it stinks.

fields.name: Psionic Fury
fields.desc: This mindstar constantly shakes and vibrates, as if a powerful force is desperately trying to escape.
use_power: release a wave of psionic power, dealing %0.2f mind damage (based on Willpower) to all within radius %d
%s's %s sends out a blast of psionic energy!

fields.name: Storm Bringer's Gauntlets
fields.desc: This pair of fine mesh voratun gauntlets is covered with glyphs of power that spark with azure energy.  The metal is supple and light so as not to interfere with spell-casting.  When and where these gauntlets were forged is a mystery, but odds are the crafter knew a thing or two about magic.

fields.name: River's Fury
fields.desc: This gorgeous and ornate trident was wielded by Lady Nashva, and when you hold it, you can faintly hear the roar of a rushing river.

fields.name: Unerring Scalpel
fields.desc: This scalpel was used by the dread sorcerer Kor'Pul when he began learning the necromantic arts in the Age of Dusk.  Many were the bodies, living and dead, that became unwilling victims of his terrible experiments.

fields.name: Wyrmbreath
fields.desc: These dragon scale gloves are tipped with the claws and teeth of a vicious Wyrm. The gloves are warm to the touch.

fields.name: Eye of the Dreaming One
fields.desc: This ethereal eye stares eternally, as if seeing things that do not truly exist.

fields.name: Rungof's Fang
fields.desc: A fang from the great warg, Rungof, still covered in blood.

fields.name: Khulmanar's Wrath
fields.desc: Blackened with soot and covered in spikes, this battleaxe roars with the flames of the Fearscape. Given by Urh'Rok himself to his general, this powerful weapon can burn even the most resilient of foes.

fields.name: Bladed Rift
fields.desc: Upon defeat, Ak'Gishil collapsed into this tiny rift. How it remains stable, you are unsure. If you focus, you think you can call forth a sword from it.

fields.name: Blade of Distorted Time
fields.desc: The remnants of a damaged timeline, this blade shifts and fades at random.
combat: deals %d temporal damage and slows enemies in radius 6 of the target by %d%% based on Magic

fields.name: Rune of Reflection
fields.desc: You can see your own image mirrored in the surface of this silvery rune.

fields.name: The Gaping Maw
fields.desc: This huge granite battleaxe is as much mace as it is axe.  The shaft is made of blackened wood tightly bound in drakeskin leather and the sharpened granite head glistens with a viscous green fluid.
combat: deal manaburn damage equal to your mindpower in a radius 3 cone

fields.desc: Longbows are used to shoot arrows at your foes.
Arrows are used with bows to pierce your foes to death.

fields.name: Elixir of the Fox
fields.desc: A vial of pink, airy fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your dexterity and cunning by three
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has given you foxlike physical and mental agility!

fields.name: Elixir of Avoidance
fields.desc: A vial of opaque green fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your defense and ranged defense by six
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has improved your defensive instincts!

fields.name: Elixir of Precision
fields.desc: A vial of chunky red fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your physical critical strike chance by 4%
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has improved your eye for an enemy's weak points!

fields.name: Elixir of Mysticism
fields.desc: A vial of glowing cyan fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your magic and willpower by three
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has augmented your magical and mental capacity!

fields.name: Elixir of the Savior
fields.desc: A vial of bubbling, slate-colored fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase all your saving throws by 4
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has improved your resistance to unpleasant effects!

fields.name: Elixir of Mastery
fields.desc: A vial of thick maroon fluid.
use_simple: grant you four additional stat points
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has greatly expanded your capacity for improving your mind and body.

fields.name: Elixir of Explosive Force
fields.desc: A vial of churning orange fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your chance to critically strike with spells by 4%
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has improved your eye for an enemy's magical weak points!

fields.name: Elixir of Serendipity
fields.desc: A vial of lively yellow fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your luck by 5
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir seems to have subtly repositioned your entire being within the fabric of reality!

fields.name: Elixir of Focus
fields.desc: A vial of clear, steaming fluid.
use_simple: grant you two additional class talent points
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has improved your capacity for exercising your core talents.

fields.name: Elixir of Brawn
fields.desc: A vial of sluggish tan fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your strength and constitution by three
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has augmented your physical might and resilience!

fields.name: Elixir of Stoneskin
fields.desc: A vial of grainy, iron-colored fluid.
use_simple: permanently increase your armor by four
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has reinforced your entire body!

fields.name: Elixir of Foundations
fields.desc: A vial of murky white fluid.
use_simple: grant you two additional generic talent points
#00FFFF#You drink the elixir and feel forever transformed!
#00FF00#The elixir has improved your capacity for exercising your core talents.

fields.name: Lifebinding Emerald
fields.desc: A lopsided, heavy emerald with murky green clouds shifting sluggishly under the surface.

fields.name: Elixir of Invulnerability
fields.desc: A vial of thick fluid, metallic and reflective. It's incredibly heavy.
use_simple: grant you complete invulnerability for five turns
#00FF00#You feel indestructible!

fields.desc: A cloth coat typically worn as a loose outer garment. It is spacious enough to be worn even over bulky metal armour.
A cloth vestment. It offers no intrinsic protection but can be enchanted.
Allows you to dig a wall, remove a tree, create ways.

fields.name: length of troll intestine
fields.desc: A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
fields.alch: Kindly empty it before returning.

fields.name: skeleton mage skull
fields.desc: The skull of a skeleton mage. The eyes have stopped glowing... for now.
fields.alch: If the eyes are still glowing, please bash it around a bit until they fade. I'll not have another one of those coming alive and wreaking havoc in my lab.

fields.name: ritch stinger
fields.desc: A ritch stinger, still glistening with venom.
fields.alch: Keep as much venom in it as possible.

fields.name: orc heart
fields.desc: The heart of an orc. Perhaps surprisingly, it isn't green.
fields.alch: If you can fetch me a still-beating orc heart, that would be even better. But you don't look like a master necromancer to me.

fields.name: naga tongue
fields.desc: A severed naga tongue. It reeks of brine.
fields.alch: Best results occur with tongues never tainted by profanity, so if you happen to know any saintly nagas...

fields.name: vial of greater demon bile
fields.desc: A vial of greater demon bile. It hurts your sinuses even with the vial's stopper firmly in place.
fields.alch: Don't drink it, even if it tells you to.

fields.name: pouch of bone giant dust
fields.desc: Once the magics animating the bone giant fled, its remains crumbled to dust. It might be your imagination, but it looks like the dust occasionally stirs on its own.
fields.alch: Never, ever to be confused with garlic powder. Trust me.

fields.name: ice ant stinger
fields.desc: Wickedly sharp and still freezing cold.
fields.alch: If you've the means to eliminate the little venom problem, these make miraculous instant drink-chilling straws.

fields.name: minotaur nose
fields.desc: The severed front half of a minotaur snout, ring and all.
fields.alch: You'll need to find one with a ring, preferably an expensive one.

fields.name: vial of elder vampire blood
fields.desc: Thick, clotted, and foul. The vial is cold to the touch.
fields.alch: Once you've gotten it, cross some moving water on your way back.

fields.name: multi-hued wyrm scale
fields.desc: Beautiful and nearly impregnable. Separating it from the dragon must have been hard work.
fields.alch: If you think collecting one of these is hard, try liquefying one.

fields.name: giant spider spinneret
fields.desc: An ugly, ripped-out chunk of giant spider. Bits of silk protrude from an orifice.
fields.alch: The spiders in your barn won't do. You'll know a giant spider when you see one, though they're rare in Maj'Eyal.

fields.name: honey tree root
fields.desc: The severed end of one of a honey tree's roots. It wriggles around occasionally, seemingly unwilling to admit that it's dead... and a *plant*.
fields.alch: Keep a firm grip on it. These things will dig themselves right back into the ground if you drop them.

fields.name: bloated horror heart
fields.desc: Diseased-looking and reeking. It seems to be decaying as you watch.
fields.alch: Don't worry if it dissolves. Just don't get any on you.

fields.name: electric eel tail
fields.desc: Slimy, wriggling, and crackling with electricity.
fields.alch: I know, I know. Where does the eel stop and the tail start? It doesn't much matter. The last ten inches or so should do nicely.

fields.name: vial of squid ink
fields.desc: Thick, black and opaque.
fields.alch: However annoying this will be for you to gather, I promise that the reek it produces in my lab will prove even more annoying.

fields.name: bear paw
fields.desc: Large and hairy with flesh-rending claws. It smells slightly of fish.
fields.alch: You'd think I could get one of these from a local hunter, but they've had no luck. Don't get eaten.

fields.name: ice wyrm tooth
fields.desc: This tooth has been blunted with age, but still looks more than capable of doing its job.
fields.alch: Ice Wyrms lose teeth fairly often, so you might get lucky and not have to do battle with one. But dress warm just in case.

fields.name: red crystal shard
fields.desc: Tiny flames still dance ethereally inside this transparent crystal, though its heat seems to have faded... you hope.
fields.alch: I hear these can be found in a cave near Elvala. I also hear that they can cause you to spontaneously combust, so no need to explain if you come back hideously scarred.

fields.name: vial of fire wyrm saliva
fields.desc: Clear and slightly thicker than water. It froths when shaken.
fields.alch: Keep this stuff well away from your campfire unless you want me to have to find a new, more alive adventurer.

fields.name: chunk of ghoul flesh
fields.desc: Rotten and reeking. It still twitches occasionally.
fields.alch: Unfortunately for you, the chunks that regularly fall off ghouls won't do. I need one freshly carved off.

fields.name: mummified bone
fields.desc: Bits of dry flesh still cling to this ancient bone.
fields.alch: That is, a bone from a corpse that's undergone mummification. Actually, any bit of the body would do, but the bones are the only parts you're certain to find when you kick a mummy apart. I recommend finding one that doesn't apply curses.

fields.name: sandworm tooth
fields.desc: Tiny, dark grey, and wickedly sharp. It looks more like rock than bone.
fields.alch: Yes, sandworms have teeth. They're just very small and well back from where you're ever likely to see them and live.

fields.name: black mamba head
fields.desc: Unlike the rest of the black mamba, the severed head isn't moving.
fields.alch: If you get bitten, I can save your life if you still manage to bring back the head... and if it happens within about a minute from my door. Good luck.

fields.name: snow giant kidney
fields.desc: As unpleasant-looking as any exposed organ.
fields.alch: I suggest not killing the snow giant by impaling it through the kidneys. You'll just have to find another.

fields.name: storm wyrm claw
fields.desc: Bluish and wickedly sharp. It makes your arm hair stand on end.
fields.alch: I recommend severing one of their dewclaws. They're smaller and easier to remove, but they've never been blunted by use, so be careful you don't poke yourself. Oh yes, and don't get eaten.

fields.name: green worm
fields.desc: A dead green worm, painstakingly separated from its tangle of companions.
fields.alch: Try to get any knots out before returning. Wear gloves.

fields.name: vial of wight ectoplasm
fields.desc: Cloudy and thick. Only by bottling it can you prevent it from evaporating within minutes.
fields.alch: If you ingest any of this, never mind coming back here. Please.

fields.name: xorn fragment
fields.desc: Looks much like any other rock, though this one was recently sentient and trying to murder you.
fields.alch: Avoid fragments that contained the xorn's eyes. You've no idea how unpleasant it is being watched by your ingredients.

fields.name: warg claw
fields.desc: Unpleasantly large and sharp for a canine's claw.
fields.alch: My usual ingredient gatherers draw the line at hunting wargs. Feel free to mock them on your way back.

fields.name: pouch of faeros ash
fields.desc: Unremarkable grey ash.
fields.alch: They're creatures of pure flame, and likely of extraplanar origin, but the ash of objects consumed by their fire has remarkable properties.

fields.name: wretchling eyeball
fields.desc: Small and bloodshot. Its dead gaze still burns your skin.
fields.alch: Evil little things, wretchlings. Feel free to kill as many as you can, though I just need the one intact eyeball.

fields.name: faerlhing fang
fields.desc: It still drips venom and crackles with magical energy.
fields.alch: I've lost a number of adventurers to this one, but I'm sure you'll be fine.

fields.name: vampire lord fang
fields.desc: Brilliantly white, but surrounded by blackest magic.
fields.alch: You should definitely consider not pricking yourself with it.

fields.name: hummerhorn wing
fields.desc: Translucent and delicate-looking, but surprisingly durable.
fields.alch: If you've not encountered hummerhorns before, they're like wasps, only gigantic and lethal.

fields.name: pouch of luminous horror dust
fields.desc: Weightless and glowing; not your usual dust.
fields.alch: Not to be confused with radiant horrors. If you encounter the latter, then I suppose there are always more adventurers.

fields.desc: Metal gloves protecting the hands up to the middle of the lower arm.
Gems can be sold for money or used in arcane rituals.
Light gloves which do not seriously hinder finger movements, while still protecting the hands somewhat.
A suit of armour made of mail.
Heavy boots, with metal strips at the toes, heels and other vulnerable parts, to better protect the wearer's feet from harm.
A large helmet that can protect the entire head. Ventilation and bad vision can be a problem, however.
Rings make your fingers look great!
Amulets make your neck look great!
Sharp, short and deadly.
A belt that goes around your waist.
A pair of boots made of leather.
A cap made of leather.
A suit of armour made of leather.
Light up the dark places of the world!

fields.name: brass lantern
fields.desc: A brass container with a wick emerging from it, protected from draughts by a sheet of greased paper. It can be carried by a handle.

fields.name: alchemist's lamp
fields.desc: A normal brass lantern, enhanced by alchemy to make it brighter.

fields.name: dwarven lantern
fields.desc: Made by the Dwarves, this lantern provides light in the darkest recesses of the earth.
