fields.lore: sunwall-note-
fields.desc: A paper scrap containing some lore.
Blunt and deadly.
A suit of armour made of metal plates.

Mindstars are natural products. Natural gems covered in living matter, they are used to focus the mental powers of all nature defenders and psionics.
Using mindstars in the offhand does not incur the normal offhand damage penalty.
A miscellaneous tool.
All that glitters is not gold; all that is gold does not glitter.
A mount.
Decaying mummy wrappings.

fields.name: Ancient Tome titled 'Gems and their uses'

fields.desc: Magical potions can have wildly different effects, from healing to killing you -- beware! Most of them function better with a high Magic score.

fields.name: Staff of Absorption
fields.desc:
Carved with runes of power, this staff seems to have been made long ago, yet it bears no signs of tarnish.
Light around it seems to dim and you can feel its tremendous power simply by touching it.
use_power: This power seems too much to wield; you fear it might absorb YOU.

fields.name: Orb of Many Ways
fields.desc:
The orb projects images of distant places, some that seem to be not of this world, switching rapidly.
If used near a portal it could probably activate it.
use_power: There is no portal to activate here.

fields.name: Orb of Many Ways
fields.desc:
The orb projects images of distant places, some that seem to be not of this world, switching rapidly.
If used near a portal it could probably activate it.
use_power: #VIOLET#The world twists sickeningly around you and you find yourself someplace unexpected! It felt nothing like your previous uses of the Orb of Many Ways. Tannen must have switched the Orb out for a fake!
It felt nothing like your previous uses of the Orb of Many Ways. Tannen must have switched the Orb out for a fake!
There is no portal to activate here.

fields.name: Orb of Undeath (Orb of Command)
fields.desc: Dark visions fill your mind as you lift the orb. It is cold to the touch.

fields.name: Dragon Orb (Orb of Command)
fields.desc: This orb is warm to the touch.

fields.name: Elemental Orb (Orb of Command)
fields.desc: Flames swirl on the icy surface of this orb.

fields.name: Orb of Destruction (Orb of Command)
fields.desc: Visions of death and destruction fill your mind as you lift this orb.

fields.name: Scrying Orb
fields.desc: This orb will automatically identify items you find.

fields.name: Rod of Recall
fields.desc:
This rod is made entirely of voratun, infused with raw magical energies that can bend space itself.
You have heard of such items before. They are very useful to adventurers, allowing faster travel.
use_power: recall the user to the worldmap after 40 turns
The rod emits a strange noise, glows briefly and returns to normal.
Space around you starts to dissolve...
The Fortress Shadow warned you that trying to force a recall without finding the portal back could break the exploratory farportal forever.
Space around you starts to dissolve...
The rod emits a strange noise, glows briefly and returns to normal.

fields.name: Transmogrification Chest
fields.desc:
This chest is an extension of old Sher'tul places of power. Any items dropped inside are transported to an other place, processed and destroyed to extract energy.
The byproduct of this effect is the creation of gold, which is useless to process, so it is sent back to you.

When you possess the chest all items you walk upon will automatically be put inside and transmogrified when you leave the level.
Simply go to your inventory to move them out of the chest if you wish to keep them.
Items in the chest will not encumber you.
use_power: transmogrify all the items in your chest at once (also done automatically when you change level)
Make the Transmogrification Chest the default item's destroyer?
You do not have any items to transmogrify in your chest or on the floor.
Transmogrify all %s item(s) on the floor?
Transmogrify all %s item(s) in your chest?

fields.name: Bikini
fields.desc:
Revealing, pink, fun.
#{bold}#If you never take it off and win you will gain a neat achievement and bragging rights!#{normal}#

fields.name: Mankini
fields.desc:
Revealing, green, fun.
#{bold}#If you never take it off and win you will gain a neat achievement and bragging rights!#{normal}#
Magical scrolls can have wildly different effects!
Natural infusions may be grafted onto your body, granting you an on-demand nature talent.
use_simple: inscribe your skin with the infusion

fields.desc: Magical runes may be inscribed onto your body, granting you an on-demand spell talent.
use_simple: inscribe your skin with the rune

fields.desc: Corrupted taints may be inscribed onto your body, granting you an on-demand ability.
use_simple: inscribe your skin with the taint

fields.desc: This parchment contains some lore.
use_simple: read it

fields.desc: This parchment contains some lore.
use_simple: read it

fields.desc: Handheld deflection devices.
Slings are used to hurl stones or metal shots at your foes.
Shots are used with slings to pummel your foes to death.

fields.name: Telos Spire of Power
fields.desc: Telos was an extremely powerful mage during the Age of Dusk, hated by his peers and feared by the common folk; he was hunted for a long while. He finally fell from his place of power, Telmur, but his spirit still lingers.
use_power: turn into a corrupted losgoroth (poison, disease, cut and confusion immune; converts half damage into life drain; does not require breath) for 10 turns
%s brandishes %s %s, turning into a corrupted losgoroth!

fields.desc: Staves designed for wielders of magic, by the greats of the art.
Sharp, long, and deadly.
Torques are made by powerful psionics to store psionic powers.
Natural totems are made by powerful wilders to store nature power.
Magical wands are made by powerful Alchemists and Archmagi to store spells. Anybody can use them to release the spells.
Sharp, long and deadly.
A pointy cloth hat, very wizardly...

fields.name: Scroll of Summoning (Limmir the Jeweler)
use_power: summon Limmir the jeweler at the center of the lake of the moon

identity: Pendant of the Sun and Moons

fields.name: Pendant of the Sun and Moons
fields.desc: This small pendant depicts a hematite moon eclipsing a golden sun and according to legend was worn by one of the Sunwall's founders.

fields.name: Unsetting Sun
fields.desc: When Elmio Panason, captain of the Vanguard, first sought shelter for his shipwrecked crew, he reflected the last rays of the setting sun off his shield.  Where the beam hit they rested and built the settlement that would become the Sunwall.  In the dark days that followed the shield became a symbol of hope for a better future.
set_desc: Glows brightly in the light of dawn.

fields.name: Scorched Boots
fields.desc: The master blood mage Ru'Khan was the first orc to experiment with the power of the Sher'Tul farportals in the Age of Pyre.  However, that first experiment was not particularly successful, and after the explosion of energy all that could be found of Ru'Khan was a pair of scorched boots.

fields.name: Goedalath Rock
fields.desc: A small rock that seems from beyond this world, vibrating with a fierce energy.  It feels warped and terrible and evil... and yet oh so powerful.

fields.name: Threads of Fate
fields.desc: Untouched by the ravages of time, this fine spun white cloak appears to be crafted of an otherworldly material that shifts and shimmers in the light.

fields.name: Blood-Edge
fields.desc:
This deep red sword weeps blood continuously. It was born in the labs of the orcish corrupter Hurik, who sought to make a crystal that would house his soul after death. But his plans were disrupted by a band of sun paladins, and though most died purging his keep of dread minions, their leader Raasul fought through to Hurik's lab, sword in hand. There the two did battle, blade against blood magic, till both fell to the floor with weeping wounds. The orc with his last strength crawled towards his fashioned phylactery, hoping to save himself, but Raasul saw his plans and struck the crystal with his light-bathed sword. It shattered, and in the sudden impulse of energies the steel, crystal and blood were fused into one.
Now the broken fragments of Raasul's soul are trapped in this terrible artifact, his mind warped beyond all sanity by decades of imprisonment. Only the taste of blood calls him forth, his soul stealing the lifeblood of others to take on physical form again, that he may thrash and wail against the living.
combat: 15% chance to animate a bleeding foe's blood

A haze of blood, vibrant and pulsing through the air, possessed by a warped and cracked soul. Every now and then a scream or wail of agony garbles through it, telling of the mindless suffering undergone by its possessor.
#GOLD#As the blade touches %s's spilt blood, the blood rises, animated!
#GOLD#%s draws power from the spilt blood!

fields.name: Dawn's Blade
fields.desc: Said to have been forged in the earliest days of the Sunwall, this longsword shines with the light of daybreak, capable of banishing all shadows.
use_power: invoke dawn, inflicting %0.2f light damage in radius %d (based on Magic) and lighting the area within radius %d
%s raises %s and sends out a burst of light!
set_desc: If the sun doesn't set, dawn's power lasts forever.

fields.name: Zemekkys' Broken Hourglass
fields.desc: This small broken hourglass hangs from a thin gold chain.  The glass is cracked and the sand has long since escaped.

fields.name: Mandible of Ungolmor
fields.desc: This obsidian-crafted, curved blade is studded with the deadly fangs of the Ungolmor. It seems to drain light from the world around it.
combat: inflicts spydric poison dealing 200 damage over 3 turns and pinning the target

fields.name: Kinetic Spike
fields.desc: A simple, rudely crafted stone hilt, this object manifests a blade of wavering, nearly invisible force, like a heat haze, as you grasp it. Despite its simple appearance, it is capable of shearing through solid granite, in the hands of those with the necessary mental fortitude to use it properly.
use_power: fire a bolt of kinetic force (range %d), dealing 150%% (physical) weapon damage
The %s fires a bolt of kinetic force!

fields.name: Rod of Sarrilon
fields.desc: A plain looking ceremonial rod. It has connections with Time that even chronomancers do not yet understand.

fields.name: Penitence
fields.desc: A powerful staff sent in secret to Angolwen by the Shaloren, to aid their fighting of the plagues following the Spellblaze. Its power is not to harm, but to heal and protect.
use_power: cure up to %d diseases or poisons (based on Magic)

fields.name: Lost Staff of Archmage Tarelion
fields.desc: Archmage Tarelion travelled the world in his youth. But the world is not a nice place and it seems he had to run fast.

fields.name: Spellblaze Echoes
fields.desc: This ancient charm still retains a distant echo of the destruction wrought by the Spellblaze
use_power: unleash a destructive wail, destroying terrain and dealing %0.2f physical damage (based on Magic) in a radius of %d

fields.name: Daneth's Neckguard
fields.desc: A thick steel gorget designed to protect its wearer from fatal attacks to the neck.  This particular gorget was worn by the Halfling General Daneth Tendermourn during the pyre wars, and judging by the marks along its surface may have saved the General's life on more than one occasion.

fields.name: Thaloren-Tree Longbow
fields.desc: In the aftermath of the Spellblaze, the Thaloren had to defend their forests against foes and fires alike. Many of the trees died despite the efforts of the Elves to save them. Their wood was fashioned into a bow to be wielded against the darkness.

fields.name: Corpsebow
fields.desc: A lost artifact of the Age of Dusk, the Corpsebow is filled with a lingering essence of that era's terrible plagues. Those struck by arrows fired from its rotten string find themselves afflicted by echoes of ancient sickness.

fields.name: Spellblade
fields.desc: Mages sometimes have funny ideas. Archmage Varil once learned how to handle a sword and found he preferred wielding it instead of his staff.

fields.name: Genocide
fields.desc: Farian was King Toknor's captain, and fought by his side in the great Battle of Last Hope.  However, when he returned after the battle to find his hometown burnt in an orcish pyre, a madness overtook him.  The desire for vengeance made him quit the army and strike out on his own, lightly armoured and carrying nought but his sword.  Most thought him dead until the reports came back of a fell figure tearing through the orcish encampments, slaughtering all before him and mercilessly butchering the corpses after.  It is said his blade drank the blood of 100 orcs each day until finally all of Maj'Eyal was cleared of their presence.  When the final orc was slain and no more were to be found, Farian at the last turned the blade on himself and stuck it through his chest.  Those nearby said his body shook with convulsions as he did so, though they could not tell whether he was laughing or crying.

fields.name: Bolbum's Big Knocker
fields.desc: A thick staff with a heavy knob on the end.  It was said to be used by the grand alchemist Bolbum in the Age of Allure.  Much renowned is the fear of his students for their master, and the high rate of cranial injuries amongst them.  Bolbum died with seven daggers in his back and his much-cursed staff went missing after.

fields.name: Guidance
fields.desc:
Said to have once belonged to Inquisitor Marcus Dunn during the Spellhunt this fist sized quartz crystal glows constantly with a soft white light and was rumoured to be a great aid in meditation, helping focus the mind, body, and soul of the owner as well as protecting them from the foulest of magics.
It seems somebody well versed in antimagic could use it to its fullest potential.

fields.name: Eldoral Last Resort
fields.desc: A sling with an inscription on its handle: 'May the wielder be granted cunning in his fight against the darkness'.

fields.name: Orc Feller
fields.desc: During the invasion of Eldoral the Halfling Rogue Herah is said to have slain over one hundred orcs while defending a group of refugees.

fields.name: Nature's Vengeance
fields.desc: This thick-set mace was used by the Spellhunter Vorlan, who crafted it from the wood of an ancient oak that was uprooted during the Spellblaze.  Many were the wizards and witches felled by this weapon, brought to justice for the crimes they committed against nature.

fields.name: Fists of the Desert Scorpion
fields.desc:
These wickedly spiked gauntlets belonged to an orc captain in the Age of Pyre who conquered the western sands, using them as a base to lay raids on Elvala to the south.  Known as The Scorpion, he seemed unconquerable in battle, able to pull enemies towards him with vicious mental force and lay down lethal blows on them.  Often a flurry of these yellow and black gauntlets would be the last thing great Shaloren mages would see before having the life crushed from them.

Finally The Scorpion was defeated by the alchemist Nessylia, who went to face the fiendish orc alone.  The captain pulled the elf towards him with a brutish cackle, but before he could batter the life from her flesh she tore off her robes, revealing eighty incendiary bombs strapped to her flesh.  With a spark from her fingers she triggered an explosion that could be seen for miles around.  To this day Nessylia is still remembered in song for the sacrifice of her immortal life to protect her people.

fields.name: Wind's Whisper
fields.desc: When the enchanter Razeen was cornered by Spellhunters near the Daikara mountain pass she wrapped her cloak about her and fled down a narrow ravine.  The hunters fired volley after volley of arrows at her, but by miracle or magic they all missed.  Razeen was able to escape and flee to the hidden city in the west.

fields.name: Gwai's Burninator
fields.desc: Gwai, a Pyromanceress that lived during the Spellhunt, was cornered by group of mage hunters. She fought to her last breath and is said to have killed at least ten people with this wand before she fell.
use_power: shoot a cone of flames (radius %d) for %0.2f fire damage (based on Magic)

fields.name: Drake's Bane
fields.desc: The killing of Kroltar, mightiest of wyrms, took seven months and the lives of 20,000 dwarven warriors.  Finally the beast was worn down and mastersmith Gruxim, standing atop the bodies of his fallen comrades, was able slit its throat with this axe crafted purely for the purpose of penetrating the wyrm's hide.

fields.name: Blood-Letter
fields.desc: A hand axe carved out of the most frozen parts of the northern wasteland.

fields.name: Telos's Staff Crystal
fields.desc: A closer look at this pure white crystal reveals that it is really a plethora of colors swirling and scintillating.
use_power: You fix the crystal on the %s and create the %s.

fields.name: Voice of Telos
fields.desc: A closer look at this pure white staff reveals that it is really a plethora of colors swirling and scintillating.

fields.name: Rope Belt of the Thaloren
fields.desc: The simplest of belts, worn for centuries by Nessilla Tantaelen as she tended to her people and forests. Some of her wisdom and power have settled permanently into its fibers.

fields.name: Neira's Memory
fields.desc: Ages ago this belt was worn by Linaniil herself in her youth, using its power she shielded herself from the Spellblaze rain of fire, but naught could she do for her sister Neira.
use_power: surround yourself with a magical shield (strength %d, based on Magic) for %d turns

fields.name: Nature's Blessing
fields.unided_name: supple leather armour entwined with willow bark
fields.desc: Worn by Protector Ardon, who first formed the Ziguranth during the mage wars between the Humans and the Halflings.  This armour is infused with the powers of nature, and protected against the disruptive forces of magic.

fields.name: Plate Armor of the King
fields.desc: Beautifully detailed with images of King Toknor's defence of Last Hope. Despair fills the hearts of even the blackest villains at the sight of it.

fields.name: Witch-Bane
fields.desc:
A thin voratun blade with an ivory handle wrapped in purple cloth.  The weapon is nearly as legendary as its former owner, Marcus Dunn, and was thought to have been destroyed after Marcus was slain near the end of the Spellhunt.
It seems somebody well versed in antimagic could use it to its fullest potential.

fields.name: Staff of Arcane Supremacy
fields.desc:
A long slender staff, made of ancient dragon-bone, with runes emblazoned all over its surface in bright silver.
It hums faintly, as if great power is locked within, yet alone it seems incomplete.
set_desc: A true understanding of the arcane is needed to release its full power.

fields.name: Hat of Arcane Understanding
fields.desc:
A traditional pointed wizard's hat, made of fine purple elven-silk and decorated with bright silver runes. You sense it has been passed from ancient times, and has been born on the heads of great mages.
Touching the cloth you feel a sense of knowledge and power from bygone ages, yet it is partly sealed away, waiting for a trigger to release it.
set_desc: Only supremacy of the arcane can release its full power.

fields.name: Mirror Shards
fields.desc: Said to have been created by a powerful mage after his home was destroyed by a mob following the Spellblaze. Though he fled, his possessions were crushed, burned, and smashed. When he returned to the ruins, he made this amulet from the remains of his shattered mirror.
use_power: create a reflective shield (50%% reflection rate, %d strength, based on Magic) for %d turns

fields.name: Destala's Scales
fields.desc: This cloak is made from the scales of an infamous Venom Drake that terrorized the country side towards the end of the Age of Dusk. It was slain by a party led by Kestin Highfin, who had this cloak fashioned personally.

fields.name: Spellblaze Shard
fields.desc: This jagged crystal glows with an unnatural light. A strap of cloth is wrapped around one end, as a handle.

fields.name: Mercy
fields.desc: This dagger was used by a nameless healer during the Age of Dusk. The plagues that ravaged his town were beyond the ability of mortal man to treat, so he took to using his dagger to as an act of mercy when faced with hopeless patients. Despite his good intentions, it is now cursed with dark power, letting it kill in a single stroke against those already weakened.
combat: deals 60 physical damage increased by 1% for each 1% life the target has lost

fields.name: Thalore-Wood Cuirass
fields.desc: Expertly hewn from the bark of trees, this wooden armor provides excellent protection at a low weight.

fields.name: Windborne Azurite
fields.desc: Air currents swirl around this bright blue jewel.

fields.name: Primal Infusion
fields.desc: This wild infusion has evolved.

fields.name: Staff of Destruction
fields.desc: This unique-looking staff is carved with runes of destruction.

fields.name: Vargh Redemption
fields.desc: This azure ring seems to be always moist to the touch.
use_power: summon a radius %d tidal wave that expands slowly over %d turns, dealing %0.2f cold and %0.2f physical damage (based on Willpower) each turn, knocking opponents back, and lowering their stun resistance
%s brandishes %s, calling forth the might of the oceans!

fields.name: Ring of the Dead
fields.desc: This ring is imbued with powers from beyond the grave. It is said that those who wear it may find a new path when all other roads turn dim.

fields.name: Elemental Fury
fields.desc: This ring shines with many colors.

fields.name: Feathersteel Amulet
fields.desc: The weight of the world seems a little lighter with this amulet around your neck.

fields.name: The Far-Hand
fields.desc: You can feel this strange metallic hand wriggling around, it feels as if space distorts around it.

fields.name: Garkul's Teeth
fields.desc: Hundreds of humanoid teeth have been strung together on multiple strands of thin leather, creating this tribal necklace.  One would have to assume that these are not the teeth of Garkul the Devourer but rather the teeth of Garkul's many meals.
set_desc: Another of Garkul's heirlooms would bring out his spirit.

fields.name: Summertide Phial
fields.desc: A small crystal phial that captured Sunlight during the Summertide.
use_power: call light, dispelling darkness and lighting tiles in radius 20.(%d power, based on Willpower)

fields.name: Burning Star
fields.desc:
The first Halfling mages during the Age of Allure discovered how to capture the Sunlight and infuse gems with it.
This star is the culmination of their craft. Light radiates from its ever-shifting yellow surface.
use_power: %s brandishes the %s which radiates in all directions!

fields.name: Dúathedlen Heart
fields.desc: This dark red heart still beats despite being separated from its owner.  It also snuffs out any light source that comes near it.

fields.name: Blood of Life
fields.desc: This vial of blood was drawn from an ancient race in the Age of Haze. Some of the power and vitality of those early days of the world still flows through it. "Drink me, mortal," the red liquid seems to whisper in your thoughts. "I will bring you light beyond darkness. Those who taste my essence fear not the death of flesh. Drink me, mortal, if you value your life..."
use_simple: quaff the Blood of Life to grant an extra life
%s quaffs the %s!
Artifact:BloodOfLife:used
undead
#LIGHT_RED#You feel the Blood of Life rushing through your veins.
The Blood of Life seems to have no effect on you.

fields.name: Eden's Guile
fields.desc: The boots of a Rogue outcast, who knew that the best way to deal with a problem was to run from it.

fields.name: Fire Dragon Shield
fields.desc: This large shield was made using scales of many fire drakes from the lost land of Tar'Eyal.
on_block: 30% chance that you'll breathe fire in a cone at the attacker (if within range 6).  This can only occur up to 4 times per turn.

fields.name: Titanic
fields.desc: This shield made of the darkest stralite is huge, heavy and very solid.

fields.name: Black Mesh
fields.desc: Black, interwoven tendrils form this mesh that can be used as a shield. It reacts visibly to your touch, clinging to your arm and engulfing it in a warm, black mass.
on_block: Up to once per turn, pull an attacker up to 15 spaces away into melee range, pinning and asphyxiating it

fields.name: Rogue Plight
fields.desc: No rogue blades shall incapacitate the wearer of this armour.

fields.name: Mummified Egg-sac of Ungolë
fields.desc: Dry and dusty to the touch, it still seems to retain some shadow of life.
use_power: You cannot summon; you are suppressed!

fields.name: Helm of the Dwarven Emperors
fields.desc: A Dwarven helm embedded with a single diamond that can banish all underground shadows.

fields.name: Silent Blade
fields.desc: A thin, dark dagger that seems to meld seamlessly into the shadows.

fields.name: Moon
fields.desc: A viciously curved blade that a folk story says is made from a material that originates from the moon.  Devouring the light around it, it fades.
combat: Deal 200%% of your Cunning as Darkness damage (%d).
set_desc: The moon shines alone in a starless sky.

fields.name: Star
fields.desc: Legend tells of a blade, shining bright as a star. Forged from a material fallen from the skies, it glows.
combat: Deal 200%% of your Dexterity as Light damage (%d).
set_desc: The star shines alone in a moonless sky.

fields.name: Ring of the War Master
fields.desc: A blade-edged ring that radiates power. As you put it on, strange thoughts of pain and destruction come to your mind.

fields.name: Unstoppable Mauler
fields.desc: A huge greatmaul of incredible weight. Wielding it, you feel utterly unstoppable.

fields.name: Crooked Club
fields.desc: An oddly twisted club with a hefty weight on the end. There's something very strange about it.
combat: Reduce targets accuracy and powers by 5 (stacks 5 times)

fields.name: Spider-Silk Robe of Spydrë
fields.desc: This set of robes is made wholly of spider silk. It looks outlandish and some sages think it came from another world, probably through a farportal.

fields.name: Dragon-helm of Kroltar
fields.desc: A visored steel helm, embossed and embellished with gold, that bears as its crest the head of Kroltar, the greatest of the fire drakes.
set_desc: Kroltar's power resides in his scales.

fields.name: Crown of Command
fields.desc: This crown was worn by the Halfling king Roupar, who ruled over the Nargol lands in the Age of Dusk.  Those were dark times, and the king enforced order and discipline under the harshest of terms.  Any who deviated were punished, any who disagreed were repressed, and many disappeared without a trace into his numerous prisons.  All must be loyal to the crown or suffer dearly.  When he died without heir the crown was lost and his kingdom fell into chaos.

fields.name: Gloves of the Firm Hand
fields.desc: These gloves make you feel rock steady! These magical gloves feel really soft to the touch from the inside. On the outside, magical stones create a rough surface that is constantly shifting. When you brace yourself, a magical ray of earth energy seems to automatically bind them to the ground, granting you increased stability.

fields.name: Dakhtun's Gauntlets
fields.desc: Fashioned by Grand Smith Dakhtun in the Age of Allure, these dwarven-steel gauntlets have been etched with golden arcane runes and are said to grant the wearer unparalleled physical and magical might.

identity: Voratun Hammer of the Deep Bellow

fields.name: Voratun Hammer of the Deep Bellow
fields.desc: The legendary hammer of the Dwarven master smiths. For ages it was used to forge powerful weapons with searing heat until it became highly powerful by itself.

fields.name: Snow Giant Wraps
fields.desc: Two large pieces of leather designed to be wrapped about the hands and the forearms.  This particular pair of wraps has been enchanted, imparting the wearer with great strength.
set_desc: This would be great with a mighty matching belt.

fields.name: Mighty Girdle
fields.desc: This girdle is enchanted with mighty wards against expanding girth. Whatever the source of its wondrous strength, it will prove of great aid in the transport of awkward burdens.
set_desc: Some giant wraps would make you feel great.

fields.name: Serpentine Cloak
fields.desc: Cunning and malice seem to emanate from this cloak.

fields.name: Vestments of the Conclave
fields.desc:
An ancient set of robes that has survived from the Age of Allure. Primal magic forces inhabit it.
It was made by Humans for Humans; only they can harness the true power of the robes.

fields.name: Firewalker
fields.desc: This fiery robe was worn by the mad pyromancer Halchot, who terrorised many towns in the late Age of Dusk, burning and looting villages as they tried to recover from the Spellblaze.  Eventually he was tracked down by the Ziguranth, who cut out his tongue, chopped off his head, and rent his body to shreds.  The head was encased in a block of ice and paraded through the streets of nearby towns amidst the cheers of the locals.  Only this robe remains of the flames of Halchot.

fields.name: Robe of the Archmage
fields.desc: A plain elven-silk robe. It would be unremarkable if not for the sheer power it radiates.

fields.name: Temporal Augmentation Robe - Designed In-Style
fields.desc: Designed by a slightly quirky Paradox Mage, this robe always appears to be stylish in any time the user finds him, her, or itself in. Crafted to aid Paradox Mages through their adventures, this robe is of great help to those that understand what a wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey mess time actually is. Curiously, as a result of a particularly prolonged battle involving its fourth wearer, the robe appends a very long, multi-coloured scarf to its present wearers.
set_desc: Oddly it never produces a hat.

fields.name: Un'fezan's Cap
fields.desc:
This fez once belonged to a traveler; it always seems to be found lying around in odd locations.
#{italic}#Fezzes are cool.#{normal}#
set_desc: Needs something equally stylish and cool to go with it.

identity: Crude Iron Battle Axe of Kroll

fields.name: Crude Iron Battle Axe of Kroll
fields.desc: Made in times before the Dwarves learned beautiful craftsmanship, the rough appearance of this axe belies its great power. Only Dwarves may harness its true strength, however.

fields.name: Scorpion's Tail
fields.desc: A long whip of linked metal joints finished with a viciously sharp barb leaking terrible venom.

fields.name: Girdle of Preservation
fields.desc: A pristine belt of purest white leather with a runed voratun buckle. The ravages of neither time nor the elements have touched it.

fields.name: Girdle of the Calm Waters
fields.desc: A belt rumoured to have been worn by the Conclave healers.

fields.name: Behemoth Hide
fields.desc: A rough hide made from a massive beast.  Seeing as it's so weathered but still usable, maybe it's a bit special...

fields.name: Skin of Many
fields.desc: The stitched-together skins of many creatures. Some eyes and mouths still decorate the robe, and some still live, screaming in tortured agony.

fields.name: Iron Mail of Bloodletting
fields.desc: Blood drips continuously from this fell suit of iron, and dark magics churn almost visibly around it. Bloody ruin comes to those who stand against its wearer.

fields.name: Scale Mail of Kroltar
fields.desc: A heavy shirt of scale mail constructed from the remains of Kroltar, whose armour was like tenfold shields.
set_desc: Kroltar's head would turn up the heat.

fields.name: Cuirass of the Thronesmen
fields.desc: This heavy dwarven-steel armour was created in the deepest forges of the Iron Throne. While it grants incomparable protection, it demands that you rely only on your own strength.

fields.name: Golden Three-Edged Sword 'The Truth'
fields.desc: The wise ones say that truth is a three-edged sword. And sometimes, the truth hurts.
combat: 9% chance to stun or confuse the target

fields.name: Ureslak's Femur
fields.desc: A shortened femur of the mighty prismatic dragon Ureslak, this erratic club still resonates with his volatile nature.
combat: 10% chance to shimmer to a different hue and gain powers
set_desc: What would happen if more of Ureslak's remains were reunited?

fields.name: Ureslak's Molted Scales
fields.desc: This cloak is fashioned from the scales of some large reptilian creature.  It appears to reflect every color of the rainbow.
use_power: energize the scales for 16 turns, increasing resistance to %s damage by 15%% just before you are damaged. (This effect lasts 5 turns and only works on one type of damage.)
set_desc: It would go well with another part of Ureslak.

fields.name: Razorblade, the Cursed Waraxe
fields.desc:
This mighty axe can cleave through armour like the sharpest swords, yet hit with all the impact of a heavy club.
It is said the wielder will slowly grow mad. This, however, has never been proven - no known possessor of this item has lived to tell the tale.

fields.name: Sword of Potential Futures
fields.desc: Legend has it this blade is one of a pair: twin blades forged in the earliest of days of the Wardens. To an untrained wielder it is less than perfect; to a Warden, it represents the untapped potential of time.
set_desc: In the past there was a dagger with it.

fields.name: Dagger of the Past
fields.desc: Legend has it this blade is one of a pair: twin blades forged in the earliest of days of the Wardens. To an untrained wielder it is less than perfect; to a Warden, it represents the opportunity to learn from the mistakes of the past.
set_desc: Potentially it would go with a sword in the future.

fields.name: Stone Gauntlets of Harkor'Zun
fields.desc: Fashioned in ancient times by cultists of Harkor'Zun, these heavy granite gauntlets were designed to protect the wearer from the wrath of their dark master.

fields.name: Unflinching Eye
fields.desc: Someone has strung a thick black cord through this large bloodshot eyeball, allowing it to be worn around the neck, should you so choose.

fields.name: Pick of Dwarven Emperors
fields.desc: This ancient pickaxe was used to pass down dwarven legends from one generation to the next. Every bit of the head and shaft is covered in runes that recount the stories of the dwarven people.

fields.name: Quiver of the Sun
fields.desc: This strange orange quiver is made of brass and etched with many bright red runes that glow and glitter in the light.  The arrows themselves appear to be solid shafts of blazing hot light, like rays of sunshine, hammered and forged into a solid state.

fields.name: Quiver of Domination
fields.desc: Powerful telepathic forces emanate from the arrows of this quiver. The tips appear dull, but touching them causes you intense pain.

fields.name: Blightstopper
fields.desc: This voratun shield, coated with thick vines, was imbued with nature's power long ago by the Halfling General Almadar Riul, who used it to stave off the magic and diseases of orcish corruptors during the peak of the Pyre Wars.
use_power: purge up to %d diseases (based on Willpower) and gain disease immunity, %d%% blight resistance, and %d spell save for 5 turns

fields.name: Star Shot
fields.desc: Intense heat radiates from this powerful shot.

fields.name: Nexus of the Way
fields.desc: The vast psionic force of the Way reverberates through this gemstone. With a single touch, you can sense overwhelming power, and hear countless thoughts.

fields.name: Amethyst of Sanctuary
fields.desc: This bright violet gem exudes a calming, focusing force. Holding it, you feel protected against outside forces.

fields.name: Sceptre of the Archlich
fields.desc: This sceptre, carved of ancient, blackened bone, holds a single gem of deep obsidian. You feel a dark power from deep within, looking to get out.
set_desc: It desires to be surrounded by undeath.

fields.name: Oozing Heart
fields.desc: This mindstar oozes a thick, caustic liquid. Magic seems to die around it.

fields.name: Bloomsoul
fields.desc: Pristine flowers coat the surface of this mindstar. Touching it fills you with a sense of calm and refreshes your body.

fields.name: Gravitational Staff
fields.desc: Time and Space seem to warp and bend around the massive tip of this stave.

fields.name: Eye of the Wyrm
fields.desc: A black iris cuts through the core of this mindstar, which shifts with myriad colours. It darts around, as if searching for something.

fields.name: Great Caller
fields.desc: This mindstar constantly emits a low tone. Life seems to be pulled towards it.

fields.name: Corrupted Gaze
fields.desc: This helmet radiates a dark power. Its visor seems to twist and corrupt the vision of its wearer. You feel worried that if you were to lower it for long, the visions may affect your mind.

fields.name: Umbral Razor
fields.desc: This dagger seems to be formed of pure shadows, with a strange miasma surrounding it.
combat: 20% chance to make the target bleed shadows. You heal for 15 whenever you hit an enemy bleeding shadows.

fields.name: Emblem of Evasion
fields.desc: Said to have belonged to a master of avoiding attacks, this gilded steel emblem symbolizes his talent.

fields.name: Surefire
fields.desc: This tightly strung bow appears to have been crafted by someone of considerable talent. When you pull the string, you feel incredible power behind it.

fields.name: Frozen Shards
fields.desc: In this dark blue pouch lie several small orbs of ice. A strange vapour surrounds them, and touching them chills you to the bone.

fields.name: Stormlash
fields.desc: This steel plated whip arcs with intense electricity. The force feels uncontrollable, explosive, powerful.
combat: Focus the lightning forces on an enemy
The storm is on your side !
use_power: strike an enemy within range %d (for 100%% weapon damage as lightning) and release a radius %d burst of electricity dealing %0.2f to %0.2f lightning damage (based on Magic and Dexterity)
#Source# strikes #Target# with %s %s, sending out an arc of lightning!

fields.name: Focus Whip
fields.desc: A small mindstar rests at top of this handle. As you touch it, a translucent cord appears, flicking with your will.
combat: Try to fry your enemies brain (25% chance to brainlock)
use_power: strike all targets in a line (for 100%% weapon damage as mind) out to range 4

fields.name: Latafayn
fields.desc: This massive, flame-coated greatsword was stolen by the adventurer Kestin Highfin, during the Age of Dusk. It originally belonged to a demon named Frond'Ral the Red.  It roars with vile flames and its very existence seems to be a blight upon the lands.
use_power: accelerate burning effects on all creatures in a radius %d ball within range %d, consuming them to instantly inflict 125%% of all remaining burn damage
%s's %s lashes out in a flaming arc, intensifying the burning of %s enemies!

fields.name: Robe of Force
fields.desc: This thin cloth robe is surrounded by a pulsating shroud of telekinetic force.
use_power: send out a range %d beam of kinetic energy, dealing %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Willpower and Cunning) with knockback
%s focuses a beam of force from %s %s!

fields.name: Serpent's Glare
fields.desc: A thick venom drips from this mindstar.

fields.name: Corpathus
fields.desc: Thick straps encircle this blade. Jagged edges like teeth travel down the blade, bisecting it. It fights to overcome the straps, but lacks the strength.

fields.name: Anmalice
fields.desc: The eye on the hilt of this blade seems to glare at you, piercing your soul and mind. Tentacles surround the hilt, latching onto your hand.
combat: torments the target with many mental effects

fields.name: Morrigor
fields.desc: This heavy, ridged blade emanates magical power, yet as you grasp the handle an icy chill runs its course through your spine. You feel the disembodied presence of all those slain by it. In unison, they demand company.
combat: deal %0.2f arcane and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic) in a radius 1 around the target
swallows the victim's soul, gaining a new power
#CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
%s's %s #SALMON#CONSUMES THE SOUL#LAST# of %s, gaining the power of %s!

fields.name: Hydra's Bite
fields.desc: This three-headed stralite flail strikes with the power of a hydra. With each attack it lashes out, hitting everyone around you.
combat: hit up to two adjacent enemies

fields.name: Spellhunt Remnants
fields.desc: These once brilliant voratun gauntlets have fallen into a deep decay. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, curing the world of their influence.
use_power: destroy an arcane item (of a higher tier than the gauntlets)
#LIGHT_RED#You can not do that with a tinker attached. Remove it first.
You crush the %s, and the gloves take on an illustrious shine!

fields.name: Merkul's Second Eye
fields.desc: This bow is said to have been the tool of an infamous dwarven spy. Rumours say it allowed him to "steal" the eyes of his enemies. Adversaries struck were left alive, only to unknowingly divulge their secrets to his unwavering sight.

fields.name: Summertide
fields.desc: A bright light shines from the center of this shield. Holding it clears your mind.
use_power: send out a range %d beam, lighting its path and dealing %0.2f to %0.2f light damage (based on Willpower and Cunning)

fields.name: Wanderer's Rest
fields.desc: These boots feel nearly completely weightless. Touching them, you feel an enormous burden lifted from you.

fields.name: Silk Current
fields.desc: This deep blue robe flows and ripples as if pushed by an invisible tide.

fields.name: Skeletal Claw
fields.desc: This whip appears to have been made from a human spine. A handle sits on one end, a sharply honed claw on the other.

fields.name: Core of the Forge
fields.desc: This blazing hot mindstar beats rhythmically, releasing a burst of heat with each strike.

fields.name: Aetherwalk
fields.desc: A wispy purple aura surrounds these translucent black boots.
use_power: phase door up to range 6, within radius 2 of the target location
%s is #PURPLE#ENVELOPED#LAST# in a deep purple aura from %s %s!

fields.name: Colaryem
fields.desc: This intricate blade is impractically long and almost as wide as your body, yet contrary to its size and apparent girth it is not only light, but threatens to escape your grasp and fly away. You will need to be really strong to keep it grounded. Or really big.

fields.name: Void Quiver
fields.desc: An endless supply of arrows lay within this deep black quiver. Tiny white lights dot its surface.

fields.name: Hornet Stingers
fields.desc: A vile poison drips from the tips of these arrows.
combat: afflicts the target with a poison dealing 20 damage per turn and causing actions to fail 20% of the time for 6 turns

fields.name: Umbraphage
fields.desc: This lantern of pale white crystal holds a sphere of darkness, that yet emanates light. Everywhere it shines, darkness vanishes entirely.
use_power: release absorbed darkness in a %d radius cone with a %d%% chance to blind (based on lite radius), dealing %0.2f darkness damage (based on Mindpower and charge)
%s unshutters %s %s, unleashing a torrent of shadows!

fields.name: Spectral Cage
fields.desc: This ancient, weathered lantern glows with a pale blue light emanating from several ghostly forms trapped within.  The metal is icy cold to the touch.
use_power: release a will o' the wisp that will explode against your foes for %d cold damage (based on your Magic)
You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
A chilling, ghostly form that floats in the air.

fields.name: The Guardian's Totem
fields.desc: This totem of ancient stone oozes a thick slime from myriad cracks. Nonetheless, you sense great power within it.
use_power: call forth an immobile antimagic pillar for 10 turns.  (It spits slime, pulls in, stuns, and burns the arcane resources of your foes, while emitting an aura of silence against them within range 5, and will silence you for 5 turns when first summoned.)
You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
This massive stone pillar drips with a viscous slime. Nature's power flows through it, obliterating magic all around it...
#Source# uses %s to summon a natural guardian!

fields.name: Cloth of Dreams
fields.desc: Touching this cloak of otherworldly fabric makes you feel both drowsy yet completely aware.

fields.name: Void Shard
fields.desc: This jagged shape looks like a hole in space, yet it is solid, though light in weight.
use_power: release a radius %d burst of void energy at up to range %d, dealing %0.2f temporal and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic)

fields.name: Coral Spray
fields.desc: A chunk of jagged coral, dredged from the ocean.
on_block: 30% chance to spray freezing water (radius 4 cone) at the target.
A wave of icy water sprays out from #Source# towards #Target#!

fields.name: Shard of Insanity
fields.desc: A deep red light glows from within this damaged amulet of black stone. When you touch it, you can hear voices whispering within your mind.

fields.name: Pouch of the Subconscious
fields.desc: You find yourself constantly fighting an urge to handle this strange pouch of shot.

fields.name: Wind Worn Shot
fields.desc: These perfectly white spheres appear to have been worn down by years of exposure to strong winds.
combat: 35% chance for lightning to arc to a second target

fields.name: Spellcrusher
fields.desc: This large steel greatmaul has thick vines wrapped around the handle.

fields.name: Telekinetic Core
fields.desc: This heavy torque appears to draw nearby matter towards it.

fields.name: Spectral Blade
fields.desc: This sword appears weightless, and nearly invisible.

fields.name: Crystle's Astral Bindings
fields.desc: Said to have belonged to a lost Anorithil, stars are reflected in the myriad surfaces of these otherworldly bindings.

fields.name: Prothotipe's Prismatic Eye
fields.desc: This cracked gemstone looks faded with age. It appears to have once been the eye of a golem.

fields.name: Plate of the Blackened Mind
fields.desc: This deep black armor absorbs all light that touches it. A dark power sleeps within, primal, yet aware. When you touch the plate, you feel dark thoughts creeping into your mind.

fields.name: Tree of Life
fields.desc: This small tree-shaped totem is imbued with powerful healing energies.
use_power: take root increasing health by 300, armor by 20, and armor hardiness by 20%% but rooting you in place for 4 turns

fields.name: Ring of Growth
fields.desc: This small wooden ring has a single green stem wrapped around it. Thin leaves still seem to be growing from it.

fields.name: Wrap of Stone
fields.desc: This thick cloak is incredibly tough, yet bends and flows with ease.

fields.name: Death's Embrace
fields.desc: This deep black leather armor, wrapped with thick silk, is icy cold to the touch.
use_power: turn yourself invisible (power %d, based on Cunning and Magic) for 10 turns
%s pulls %s %s around %s like a dark shroud!

fields.name: Breath of Eyal
fields.desc: This lightweight armor appears to have been woven of countless sprouts, still curling and growing. When you put it on, you feel the weight of the world on your shoulders, in spite of how light it feels in your hands.

fields.name: Eternity's Counter
fields.desc: This hourglass of otherworldly crystal appears to be filled with countless tiny gemstones in place of sand. As they fall, you feel the flow of time change around you.
use_power: flip the hourglass (sands currently flowing towards %s)

fields.name: Malslek the Accursed's Hat
fields.desc: This black hat once belonged to a powerful mage named Malslek, in the Age of Dusk, who was known to deal with beings from other planes. In particular, he dealt with many powerful demons, until one of them, tired of his affairs, betrayed him and stole his power. In his rage, Malslek set fire to his own tower in an attempt to kill the demon. This charred hat is all that remained in the ruins.

fields.name: Fortune's Eye
fields.desc:
This finely crafted telescope once belonged to the explorer and adventurer Kestin Highfin. With this tool in hand he traveled in search of treasures all across Maj'Eyal, and before his death it was said his collection was incredibly vast. He often credited this telescope with his luck, saying that as long as he had it, he could escape any situation, no matter how dangerous. It is said he died confronting a demon seeking revenge for a stolen sword.

His last known words were "Somehow this feels like an ending, yet I know there is so much more to find."

fields.name: Eye of the Forest
fields.desc: This leather cap is overgrown with a thick moss, except for around the very front, where an eye, carved of wood, rests. A thick green slime slowly pours from the corners of the eye, like tears.

fields.name: Eyal's Will
fields.desc: This smooth green crystal flows with a light green slime in its core. Droplets occasionally form on its surface, tufts of grass growing quickly on the ground where they fall.

fields.name: Evermoss Robe
fields.desc: This thick robe is woven from a dark green moss, firmly bound and cool to the touch. It is said to have rejuvenating properties.

fields.name: Nithan's Force
fields.desc: This powerful sling is said to have belonged to a warrior so strong his shots could knock down a brick wall...

fields.name: The Titan's Quiver
fields.desc: These massive arrows are honed to a vicious sharpness, and appear to be nearly unbreakable. They seem more like spikes than any arrow you've ever seen.
combat: pin the target to the nearest wall

fields.name: Inertial Twine
fields.desc: This double-helical ring seems resistant to attempts to move it. Wearing it seems to extend this property to your entire body.

fields.name: Everpyre Blade
fields.desc: This ornate blade is carved from the wood of a tree said to burn eternally. Its hilt is encrusted with gems, suggesting it once belonged to a figure of considerable status. The flames seem to bend to the will of the sword's holder.

fields.name: Eclipse
fields.desc: This tall staff is tipped with a pitch black sphere that yet seems to give off a strong light.

fields.name: Eksatin's Ultimatum
fields.desc: This gore-stained battleaxe was once used by an infamously sadistic king, who took the time to personally perform each and every execution he ordered. He kept a vault of every head he ever removed, each and every one of them carefully preserved. When he was overthrown, his own head was added as the centrepiece of the vault, which was maintained as a testament to his cruelty.

fields.name: Radiance
fields.desc: This pristine golden cloak flows with a wind that seems to be conjured from nowhere. Its inner surface is a completely plain white, but the outside shines with intense light.

fields.name: Unbreakable Greaves
fields.desc: These titanic boots appear to have been carved from stone. They appear weathered and cracked, but easily deflect all blows.

fields.name: The Untouchable
fields.desc:
This rugged jacket is the subject of many a rural legend.
Some say it was fashioned by an adventurous mage turned rogue, in times before the Spellblaze, but was since lost.
All manner of shady gamblers have since claimed to have worn it at one point or another. To fail, but live, is what it means to be untouchable, they said.

fields.name: Honeywood Chalice
fields.desc: This wooden cup seems perpetually filled with a thick sap-like substance. Tasting it is exhilarating, and you feel intensely aware when you do so.

fields.name: The Calm
fields.desc: This green robe is engraved with icons showing clouds and swirling winds. Its original owner, a powerful mage named Proccala, was often revered for both his great benevolence and his intense power when it proved necessary.

fields.name: Omniscience
fields.desc: This white cap is plain and dull, but as the light reflects off of its surface, you see images of faraway corners of the world in the sheen."
use_power: %s grasps %s %s and has a sudden vision!

fields.name: Earthen Beads
fields.desc: This is a string of ancient, hardened clay beads, cracked and faded with age. It was used by Wilders in ancient times, in an attempt to enhance their connection with Nature.

fields.name: Hand of the World-Shaper
fields.desc: These heavy stone gauntlets make the very ground beneath you bend and warp as they move.

fields.name: Guise of the Hated
fields.desc:
Forget the moons, the starry sky,
The warm and greeting sheen of sun,
The rays of light will never reach inside,
The heart which wishes that it be unseen.

fields.name: Spelldrinker
fields.desc:
Countless mages have fallen victim to the sharp sting of this blade, betrayed by those among them with greed for ever greater power.
Passed on and on, this blade has developed a thirst of its own.
combat: steals up to 50 mana from the target

fields.name: Frost Lord's Chain
fields.desc: This impossibly cold chain of frost-coated metal radiates a strange and imposing aura.

fields.name: Twilight's Edge
fields.desc: The blade of this sword seems to have been forged of a mixture of voratun and stralite, resulting in a blend of swirling light and darkness.
combat: release a burst of light and dark damage (scales with Magic)

fields.name: Mnemonic
fields.desc: As long as you wear this ring, you will never forget who you are.

fields.name: Acera
fields.desc: This warped, blackened sword drips acid from its countless pores.

fields.name: Borosk's Hate
fields.desc: This impressive looking sword features two massive blades aligned in parallel. They seem weighted remarkably well.
combat: 25% chance to strike the target again.

fields.name: Butcher
fields.desc: Be it corruption, madness or eccentric boredom, the halfling butcher by the name of Caleb once took to eating his kin instead of cattle. His spree was never ended and nobody knows where he disappeared to. Only the blade remained, stuck fast in a bloodied block. Beneath, a carving said "This was fun, let's do it again some time."
combat: Attempt to devour a low HP enemy, striking again and possibly killing it instantly.

fields.name: Ethereal Embrace
fields.desc: This cloak waves and bends with shimmering light, reflecting the depths of space and the heart of the Aether.

fields.name: Boots of the Hunter
fields.desc: These cracked boots are caked with a thick layer of mud. It isn't clear who they previously belonged to, but they've clearly seen extensive use.
use_power: boost movement speed by 300% for up to 5 turns (or until you perform a non-movement action)

fields.name: Sludgegrip
fields.desc: These gloves are coated with a thick, green liquid.

fields.name: Ring of the Archlich
fields.desc:
This ring is filled with an overwhelming, yet restrained, power. It lashes, grasps from its metal prison, searching for life to snuff out. You alone are unharmed.
Perhaps it feels all the death you will bring to others in the near future.
set_desc: It desires to be surrounded by undeath.

fields.name: Lightbringer's Wand
fields.desc: This gold-tipped wand shines with an unnatural sheen.
use_power: summon a stationary shining orb within range %d for 15 turns that will illuminate its area and deal %d light damage (based on your Magic and Strength) to your foes within radius %d each turn
You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
#Source# points %s %s at #target#, releasing a brilliant orb of light!

fields.name: Temporal Rift
fields.desc: Some mad Chronomancer appears to have affixed a handle to this hole in spacetime. It looks highly effective, in its own strange way.

fields.name: Arkul's Siege Arrows
fields.desc: These titanic double-helical arrows seem to have been designed more for knocking down towers than for use in regular combat. They'll no doubt make short work of most foes.

fields.name: Punae's Blade
fields.desc: This very thin sword cuts through the air with ease, allowing remarkably quick movement.

fields.name: Crimson Robe
fields.desc: This robe was formerly owned by Callister the Psion, a powerful Psionic that pioneered many Psionic abilities. After his wife was murdered, Callister became obsessed with finding her killer, using his own hatred as a fuel for new and disturbing arts. After forcing the killer to torture himself to death, Callister walked the land, forcing any he found to kill themselves - his way of releasing them from the world's horrors. One day, he simply disappeared. This robe, soaked in blood, was the only thing he left behind.

fields.name: Exiler
fields.desc:
The chronomancer known as Solith was renowned across all of Eyal. He always seemed to catch his enemies alone.
In the case of opponents who weren't alone, he had to improvise.
use_power: attempt to inflict %0.2f temporal damage (based on Spellpower and Paradox, if any) on foes in a radius %d ball out to range %d (chance depends on rank, summons are always affected), removing any that survive from time for up to %d turn(s)

fields.name: Piercing Gaze
fields.desc: This gigantic shield has a stone eye embedded in it.
on_block: The eye locks onto %s, freezing it in place!

fields.name: Shantiz the Stormblade
fields.desc: This surreal dagger crackles with the intensity of a vicious storm.
combat: Causes lightning to strike and destroy any projectiles in a radius of 10, dealing damage and dazing enemies in a radius of 5 around them.

fields.name: Swordbreaker
fields.desc: This ordinary blade is made of fine, sturdy voratun and outfitted with jagged hooks along the edge. This simple appearance belies a great power - the hooked maw of this dagger broke many a blade and the stride of many would-be warriors.

fields.name: Shieldsmaiden
fields.desc: Myths tell of shieldsmaidens, a tribe of warrior women from the northern wastes of Maj'Eyal. Their martial prowess and beauty drew the fascination of swaths of admirers, yet all unrequited. So began the saying, that a shieldsmaiden's heart is as cold and unbreakable as her shield.

fields.name: Tirakai's Maul
fields.desc: This massive hammer is formed from a thick mass of strange crystalline growths. In the side of the hammer itself you see an empty slot; it looks like a gem of your own could easily fit inside it.
use_power: imbue the hammer with a gem of your choice

fields.name: Fist of the Destroyer
fields.desc: These fell looking gloves glow with untold power.
set_desc: Only the masochistic can unlock its full power.

fields.name: Masochism
fields.desc:
Stolen flesh,
	Stolen pain,
	To give it up,
	Is to live again.
set_desc: With a better grip it would be the destroyer of your enemies.

fields.name: Obliterator
fields.desc: This massive hammer strikes with deadly force. Bones crunch, splinter and grind to dust under its impact.
combat: Sends a tremor through the ground which causes jagged rocks to erupt in a beam of length 5, dealing %d Physical damage (equal to your Strength, up to 150) and causing targets hit to bleed for an additional 50 damage over 5 turns. Bleeding can stack.

fields.name: Yaldan Baoth
fields.desc: The golden bascinet crown, affiliated with Veluca of Yaldan. King of the mythical city of Yaldan, that was struck from the face of Eyal by the arrogance of its people. Lone survivor of his kin, he spent his last years wandering the early world, teaching man to stand against the darkness. With his dying words, "Fear no evil", the crown was passed onto his successor.
use_power: lower the helmet's visor, blinding yourself (and protecting from other blinds) for 6 turns. If the helmet is taken off, the effect will end early.

fields.name: Champion's Will
fields.desc: This impressive looking sword features a golden engraving of a sun in its hilt. Etched into its blade are a series of runes claiming that only one who has mastered both their body and mind may wield this sword effectively.
combat: releases a burst of light, dealing %d light damage (based on Spellpower) in a radius 3 cone.
use_power: attack everything in a line out to range %d, dealing 100%% weapon damage (as light), and healing for 50%% of the damage dealt

fields.name: Tarrasca
fields.desc: This massive suit of plate boasts an enormous bulk and overbearing weight. Said to belong to a nameless soldier who safeguarded a passage across the bridge to his village, in defiance to the cohorts of invading orcs. After days of assault failed to fell him, the orcs turned back. The man however, fell dead on the spot - from exhaustion. The armor had finally claimed his life.
use_power: slow the movement speed of all creatures (including yourself) within range 5 by 40% for 3 turns
%s rebalances the bulky plates of %s %s, and things slow down a bit.

fields.name: The Face of Fear
fields.desc: This mask appears to be carved out of the skull of a creature that never should have existed, malformed and distorted. You shiver as you look upon it, and its hollow eye sockets seem to stare back into you.

fields.name: Cinderfeet
fields.desc: A cautionary tale tells of the ancient warlock by the name of Caim, who fancied himself daily walks through Goedalath, both to test himself and the harsh demonic wastes. He was careful to never bring anything back with him, lest it provide a beacon for the demons to find him. Unfortunately, over time, his sandals drenched in the soot and ashes of the fearscape and the fire followed his footsteps outside, drawing in the conclusion of his grim fate.

fields.name: Cuirass of the Dark Lord
fields.desc: Worn by a villain long forgotten, this armor was powered by the blood of thousands of innocents. Decrepit and old, the dark lord died in solitude, his dominion crumbled, his subjects gone. Only this cuirass remained, dying to finally taste fresh blood again.
use_power: drain blood from all creatures within range 5, causing them to bleed for %0.2f physical damage over 4 turns (based on your Physicalpower). For each creature drained (up to 10), the armor gains strength, which fades over 10 turns if it is not fed

fields.name: Decayed Visage
fields.desc: A desiccated mask of human skin, all that remains of a necromancer from the Age of Pyre who failed to achieve lichdom.  The transformative process partially succeeded, leaving him unable to die as his body slowly rotted from the inside out over several years.  Now his spirit resides within this last bit of mummified flesh, still hungering for eternal life.

fields.name: Dream Malleus
fields.desc: A large shimmering maul that seems to produce a ringing in your ears.  It is both as malleable as thought and as hard as the strongest steel.

fields.name: Cloud Caller
fields.desc: This hat's broad brim protects you from biting colds and sudden storms.

fields.name: The Jolt
fields.desc: This torque feels tingly to the touch, but seems to enhance your thinking.

fields.name: Stormfront
fields.desc: The blade glows faintly blue, and reflects a sky full of stormy clouds.

fields.name: Eye of Summer
fields.desc: This mindstar glows with a bright warm light, but seems somehow incomplete.

#GREEN#You feel the seasons in perfect balance.

fields.name: Ruthless Grip
fields.desc: Crafted for a warlord who wanted to keep his subjects under a stralite grip. Dark thoughts went into the making of these gauntlets, literally.

fields.name: Icy Kill
fields.desc:
As any scryer knows, the link between the murderer and the murdered is the murder weapon, and a scryer can follow that link from the murdered to the weapon to the murderer.
One rather cold blooded killer thought of a way around this. By carving blades out of ice, they could kill as they wished and the link would just melt away.
Their killing spree ended when one of the victims got lucky and managed to stab the murderer in the heart with the icey blade. After being united with the cold heart that created it, the final ice blade has never melted.
combat: explodes a frozen creature (damage scales with willpower)

fields.name: Thunderfall
fields.desc: Tremendous power is concentrated in this heavy mace. Just dropping it can knock down nearby walls.
